evidence.excerpt: Sections 4.1–4.2 and Appendix C.1 specify Mars rule variants, structured observations, mine/attack/place/make/explore calls, and achievement reward/score.

task.zh: 在改变地形、生存规则与任务依赖的世界中完成采集和制作成就。
task.en: Unlock collection and crafting achievements in worlds with changed terrain, survival rules and task dependencies.

observation.en: Structured position, visible/nearby objects, status and inventory.

action.en: Parameterized mine, attack, sleep, place, make and explore calls.

metrics.en: Achievement/health return and geometric aggregate achievement-success score.

controls.en: Evaluate default and combinations of three rule-change families separately with learned rules after a controlled exploration phase.

limits.zh: 采用作者预印本明确的 Mars 协议；不是 Minecraft 原版，也不把 ALFWorld 任务复制到 Mars。预算具体配置尚需逐实验固定。

controls.zh: 每任务独立代理；测试视频配对；入围者最多4天训练与10小时在线人类反馈重训检查

limits.zh: 任务无预定义奖励；偏好分不是程序成功率或完整Minecraft通关
limits.en: No predefined task reward; preference scores are neither programmatic success rates nor Minecraft completion

task.en: Control Mario through levels, comparing training levels, held-out levels and off-policy starts.

observation.zh: 当前渲染帧、规则和输出格式提示；策略不读取 RAM 或帧历史。
observation.en: Current rendered frame plus rules/output prompt; no RAM or frame-history input to the policy.

action.zh: 输出最多两个同时按下的按钮，取自 a/b/上下左右/noop，按固定帧跳执行。

metrics.zh: 关卡横向进度均值及标准误；进度奖励由 RAM 位置差计算，但不提供给视觉策略。

controls.zh: 采用 10 个关卡，前 5 个用于训练；50 个训练关卡偏离状态及 50 个未见关卡状态，每关 10 个。

limits.zh: 不含两关控制方式不同的关卡；本单位未纳入跨游戏 Super Mario Bros. 实验；具体运行种子未统一。
limits.en: Two levels with different controls are excluded; cross-game Super Mario Bros. evaluation is outside this unit; run seeds are not standardized.

basis.zh: 持续视觉反馈下控制移动和跳跃。
basis.en: Movement and jumps require ongoing visual feedback.

basis.zh: 同一关卡需连续执行百余轮决策。
basis.en: A single level requires more than one hundred sequential decisions.

basis.zh: 论文明确区分训练关卡与保留的未见关卡及偏离策略状态。
basis.en: The protocol separates training levels, held-out levels and off-policy starts.

task.en: Control jumps in live levels to maximize survival before death.

observation.zh: 视觉边缘表示、短帧序列及模型时间状态。
observation.en: Visual edge representation, short frame context and temporal model state.

action.zh: 二元跳跃/不跳跃控制，经实时按键派发。
action.en: Binary jump/idle control dispatched as real-time key input.

metrics.zh: 死亡前存活帧数；PPO 相对行为克隆的差值及 bootstrap 区间；延迟另外报告。
metrics.en: Frames survived before death; PPO-minus-BC differences and bootstrap intervals; latency is reported separately.

controls.zh: 冻结确定性策略，种子 43–45，每策略种子 25 次；Stereo Madness、Back on Track、Polargeist；另有飞船片段及未见社区关卡。

limits.zh: 不代表完整通关率；训练和保留关卡范围以原文为准，重力翻转未覆盖；30/60 FPS 比较为单独实验。
limits.en: Not a full-level completion rate; train/held-out scope follows the paper, gravity inversion is excluded, and 30/60 FPS comparison is a separate experiment.

basis.zh: 跳跃必须根据实时画面和障碍时机执行。

basis.zh: 作者单列未见社区关卡及改变执行频率的测试。
basis.en: The paper explicitly separates an unseen community level and changed execution-cadence tests.

observation.zh: 84×84灰度图，堆叠4帧

action.zh: 游戏特定离散Atari动作
action.en: Game-specific discrete Atari actions

label.zh: 王者荣耀人类模型队友协作

task.zh: 四个 AI 与一个固定人类行为模型组队，与固定混合队伍进行 5v5 对局，同时提升队友目标表现。
task.en: Four agents team with one fixed human-behavior model in 5v5 matches against a fixed mixed team, improving teammate-goal outcomes.

observation.zh: 英雄、单位及比赛统计等结构化特征和空间特征；不可见敌方信息只用于训练价值网络。
observation.en: Structured hero/unit/game statistics and spatial features; hidden enemy information is restricted to the training value network.

action.zh: 移动、选定目标攻击、技能、召唤师能力、回城、物品等游戏控制。
action.en: Movement, targeted attacks, skills, summoner ability, recall and item controls.

metrics.zh: 胜率；人类模型的 MVP 分、精彩操作次数、参团率、资源量及跟随率。
metrics.en: Win rate; human-model MVP score, highlights, participation, resources and follow rate.

controls.zh: JueWu-SL 人类模型，固定对手为四个 Wukong 加一个人类模型；每配置 10,000 局、五个训练种子、95% 置信区间。
controls.en: JueWu-SL human model; fixed opponents comprise four Wukong agents and one human model; 10,000 matches per configuration, five training seeds and 95% confidence intervals.

limits.zh: 这里只纳入模拟人类队友协议，不能把代理指标当成真实人类主观体验；不合并另行开展的人类实验。
limits.en: Only the simulated-human teammate protocol is included; proxy indicators are not subjective human experience, and separate human studies are not pooled.

basis.zh: 共享团队胜利目标，同时适应人类模型队友的行为与目标。
basis.en: Agents share a team objective while adapting to a human-model teammate and its goals.

task.zh: 用合成代码世界模型进行 MCTS 搜索，并在井字棋和四子棋中完成对局。
task.en: Use a synthesized code world model for MCTS and play complete Tic-Tac-Toe and Connect Four matches.

observation.zh: 规则、轨迹用于模型合成；对局阶段读取当前棋盘状态及可用动作。
observation.en: Rules and trajectories support model synthesis; gameplay uses the current board state and available actions.

action.zh: 搜索后提交一个棋盘落子动作。
action.en: Submit one board-placement move selected by search.

metrics.zh: 按先后手报告胜/和/负，单列无效动作或超时导致的弃权。
metrics.en: Win/draw/loss by seat, separating forfeits from invalid actions or timeouts.

controls.zh: 模型合成重复五次并筛除坏样本；每场随机选择一个 CWM；每对手/座位的结果基于 100 场。
controls.en: Synthesis is repeated five times with bad samples rejected; a CWM is randomly selected per match; results use 100 matches per opponent/seat.

limits.zh: 只核验两种标准棋盘任务；不把代码状态转移准确率或其他自定义游戏结果并入；搜索预算须沿用原文。
limits.en: Only two standard board tasks are included; transition-prediction accuracy and custom-game results are excluded; search budgets must follow the paper.

basis.zh: 动作由候选未来状态的显式 MCTS 搜索决定。
basis.en: Moves are selected through explicit MCTS over candidate future states.

task.en: Two players use hints, plays and discards to build shared color stacks while unable to see their own cards.

label.zh: SPIRAL 标准训练游戏对局

task.zh: 在 TextArena 的井字棋和 Kuhn Poker 中进行完整双人零和对局，比较专项与多游戏训练策略。
task.en: Play complete two-player zero-sum Tic-Tac-Toe and Kuhn Poker games in TextArena, comparing specialist and multi-game policies.

observation.zh: 当前玩家可见的文字游戏状态、角色及规则；扑克牌对手私牌不可见。
observation.en: Textual game state visible to the active player, role and rules; the opponent private poker card is hidden.

action.zh: 从生成的回答中提取环境动作：井字棋落子或 Kuhn Poker 合法下注决策。
action.en: Extract environment actions from model responses: board placement or legal Kuhn Poker betting decisions.

metrics.zh: 逐游戏对局胜率；表 4 为专项模型互战，表 5 为固定 Gemini-2.0-Flash 对手。
metrics.en: Per-game match win rates; Table 4 uses specialist matchups, Table 5 a fixed Gemini-2.0-Flash opponent.

controls.zh: 保留 TextArena 规则、先后手/角色和固定对手版本；表 5 使用 400 步训练模型。
controls.en: Retain TextArena rules, player roles and fixed opponent version; Table 5 uses models trained for 400 steps.

limits.zh: 不把训练自博弈当成协作；本单位没有接入 OOD 游戏，因此不标泛化；本轮未确认逐单元对局总数。
limits.en: Self-play training is not cooperation; OOD games are outside this unit, so it has no generalization tag; per-cell match counts were not confirmed in this review.

basis.zh: 对手行动和零和输赢决定落子及下注的策略取舍。
basis.en: Opponent behavior and zero-sum outcomes determine placement and betting tradeoffs.

evidence.title: SPIRAL: Self-Play on Zero-Sum Games Incentivizes Reasoning via Multi-Agent Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
evidence.excerpt: Algorithm 1 executes parsed text actions in TextArena; Tables 4–5 report Tic-Tac-Toe and Kuhn Poker head-to-head win rates, including a fixed Gemini opponent.

label.zh: Student of Games 国际象棋赛

task.zh: 通过学习与搜索策略，在完整国际象棋对局中与其他棋力系统比赛。
task.en: Use learned/search policies to play complete chess games against other chess systems.

observation.zh: 完整可见棋盘与游戏状态，以及当前合法走法。
observation.en: Fully visible board/game state and legal moves.

action.zh: 提交合法棋步，由搜索策略选择。
action.en: Submit a legal chess move selected by search.

metrics.zh: 每配对的胜和负及相对 Elo；基准 Stockfish 配置的 Elo 设为 0。
metrics.en: Per-pairing outcomes and relative Elo; the reference Stockfish configuration is assigned zero Elo.

controls.zh: 每个配对 200 局，100 白方/100 黑方；SoG 与 AlphaZero 比较 8k/60k 搜索预算；明确各 Stockfish 线程/思考时间。
controls.en: 200 matches per pairing, 100 as each color; SoG/AlphaZero compare 8k/60k search budgets; Stockfish thread/time settings are specified.

limits.zh: 仅国际象棋赛；不将围棋、扑克和 Scotland Yard 的观察/指标套用至本单位；Elo 仅相对于该对手池。

observation.zh: 编码的自身底牌、公共牌、分轮下注历史与合法动作信息。

metrics.zh: 平均每手千分之一大盲收益 mbb/h。
metrics.en: Mean milli-big-blinds per hand (mbb/h).

controls.zh: 对 Slumbot 和 OpenStack 分别进行 100,000 手对战；保留该实现的动作尺度和状态编码。
controls.en: 100,000-hand comparisons against Slumbot and OpenStack; retain the implementation bet sizes and state encoding.

limits.zh: OpenStack 是作者对 DeepStack 的复现，不是原版 DeepStack；未在本轮确认匹配发牌种子，不能宣称同手牌配对控制。
limits.en: OpenStack is the authors’ DeepStack reimplementation, not original DeepStack; matched-deal seeds were not confirmed, so paired-deal control is not claimed.

basis.zh: 下注需在隐藏对手私牌和筹码风险下做收益权衡。
basis.en: Betting trades off return and chip risk with hidden opponent cards.

task.en: Deploy pieces and play complete Stratego games with hidden piece identities.

observation.zh: 自身棋子、公开棋面和对敌方棋子身份的可见信息；编码包含最近 40 步历史。

action.zh: 部署阶段选择位置；对局阶段选择合法移动的起点和终点。
action.en: Select deployment positions, then legal move origins and destinations during play.

metrics.zh: 50 场人类排位赛胜率及当时的 Kleier 评分。

limits.zh: 历史在线对手池，非固定当代排行榜；历史输入不等于独立记忆能力消融，未单独标记记忆轴。
limits.en: Historical online opponent pool, not a current fixed leaderboard; history inputs do not isolate memory ability, so no separate memory tag is assigned.

basis.zh: 隐藏棋子身份下的部署、侦察和进攻构成对抗性取舍。
basis.en: Deployment, probing and attack under hidden piece identities require adversarial tradeoffs.

task.zh: 一名地主对两名农民，选择出牌组合或过牌，完成每副牌的对抗。
task.en: Play one landlord against two peasants, choosing card combinations or pass to finish each deal.

observation.zh: 自身手牌、牌数及出牌历史等位置可见特征；历史经序列编码。
observation.en: Role-visible features including own cards, card counts and play history, with sequence encoding of history.

action.zh: 对所有合法出牌组合或 pass 打分并选择。
action.en: Score and select a legal card combination or pass.

metrics.zh: 胜率 WP 和平均分差 ADP；基础分 1，炸弹加倍。
metrics.en: Winning percentage (WP) and average difference in points (ADP); base score one, doubled by bombs.

controls.zh: 10,000 副随机牌；各位置单独比较，再汇总，地主与农民角色不混淆。
controls.en: 10,000 random deals; compare each seat separately before aggregation, preserving landlord/peasant roles.

limits.zh: 此协议不包含单独的叫牌评测；农民有团队目标但没有自然语言沟通。
limits.en: This protocol excludes the separate bidding evaluation; peasants share a team objective without natural-language communication.

basis.zh: 根据手牌、出牌历史和对手剩余牌选择牌型。
basis.en: Card choices depend on own hand, play history and opponents’ remaining cards.

basis.zh: 仅农民角色共享胜负，需要配合另一名农民阻止地主先出完。
basis.en: Only the peasant roles share outcomes and coordinate to stop the landlord finishing first.

controls.zh: 沿用共同模型与提示条件；比赛内状态可持续、比赛间重置；有多名队员时同一Agent复制且未显式告知。

limits.zh: 按论文规则和表1作编辑性能力归类；这些是同一批对局的子集视图，不是新增实验或已隔离的能力分数。团队中同一Agent可复制，不能解释为陌生伙伴协作泛化。

basis.zh: 表1将这六款列为Abstract Strategy；附录规则要求资源取舍、对手牵制或位置决策，按任务机制归为策略维度。
basis.en: Table 1 classifies these six as Abstract Strategy; their rules require resource trade-offs, opponent constraints or positional decisions, supporting an editorial strategy mapping.

task.zh: 分别在指定尺寸棋盘中训练与测试策略，通过完整对局比较学习过程。
task.en: Train and test policies separately on specified board sizes, comparing learning through complete games.

observation.zh: Pgx 当前玩家的状态观察和合法动作掩码。
observation.en: Pgx current-player state observation and legal-action mask.

action.zh: 在当前合法棋步中选择动作；依各游戏规则包括移动、落子、打入或 pass。
action.en: Select a legal move under each game rules, including movement, placement, drops or pass as applicable.

metrics.zh: 成对对局结果经 BayesElo 估计棋力，参考模型为 1,000 Elo。
metrics.en: Pairwise outcomes yield BayesElo ratings with reference models fixed at 1,000 Elo.

controls.zh: 同类网络/超参，400 轮约 105M 帧；评测每步 32 次模拟；围棋参考为 200 轮，其余为 100 轮；两次训练运行。
controls.en: Common architecture/hyperparameters, 400 iterations/about 105M frames; 32 simulations per evaluation move; Go reference at iteration 200, others at 100; two training runs.

limits.zh: 这是平台论文的具体学习评估例，不是所有 Pgx 环境；各棋类 Elo 独立，不能跨棋类比较；模拟器吞吐量不计能力。
limits.en: A concrete learning-evaluation example from a platform paper, not all Pgx environments; Elo is game-specific, and simulator throughput is not a capability metric.

basis.zh: 每步使用显式树搜索选择未来结果较优的合法棋步。
basis.en: Explicit tree search selects legal moves based on potential future outcomes.

evidence.title: Pgx: Hardware-Accelerated Parallel Game Simulators for Reinforcement Learning
evidence.excerpt: The AlphaZero evaluation trains on five specified board variants and reports pairwise BayesElo, with baseline Elo 1000 and 32 simulations per move.

task.zh: 控制一个国家，通过与其他玩家谈判和提交军队命令争夺补给中心。
task.en: Control one country, negotiating with other players and issuing military orders to contest supply centers.

observation.zh: 地图、部队和补给中心状态，以及收到的谈判消息和过去经验。
observation.en: Map, units and supply centers, received negotiation messages and prior experience.

action.zh: 生成谈判消息并提交游戏合法军队命令。
action.en: Generate negotiation messages and submit legal military orders.

metrics.zh: Win/Most SC/Survived/Defeated 比例；C-Diplo Argir 得分；胜利阈值为 34 个中心中的至少 18 个。
metrics.en: Win/Most SC/Survived/Defeated rates and C-Diplo Argir scores; victory requires at least 18 of 34 centers.

controls.zh: 通常 1,000 局，随机分配国家；分别保留 3:4、4:3 Richelieu/Cicero 混合阵容及其他对手配置。
controls.en: Typically 1,000 games with randomized countries; retain separate 3:4 and 4:3 Richelieu/Cicero mixtures and other opponent configurations.

limits.zh: §5.1 的 press/no-press 括号及“全部中心”概述有内文不一致；此处依据明确指标定义和有谈判实验，不跨阵容合并分数。
limits.en: Section 5.1 has inconsistent press/no-press parentheses and an all-centers summary; this unit follows explicit metric definitions and negotiation-enabled experiments, without pooling compositions.

basis.zh: 谈判消息、联盟承诺和对手意图会影响命令选择。
basis.en: Negotiation, alliance commitments and inferred intentions influence orders.

basis.zh: 各国竞争有限补给中心，需要选择结盟与攻防取舍。
basis.en: Countries compete for limited centers through alliance and military tradeoffs.

evidence.title: Richelieu: Self-Evolving LLM-Based Agents for AI Diplomacy
evidence.excerpt: Section 5 reports repeated Diplomacy matches, negotiation-enabled comparisons, four outcome categories and C-Diplo Argir scores, with explicit 18-of-34-center victory criteria.

label.zh: 单夜终极狼人讨论与投票
label.en: One Night Ultimate Werewolf discussion and voting

task.zh: 在五人固定夜间设置之后，通过讨论推断角色、影响他人，并投票争取己方阵营胜利。
task.en: After a fixed five-player night setup, discuss to infer roles, influence others and vote for the team outcome.

observation.zh: 自身可见角色与夜间信息、公共讨论历史；代理推断的信念不是环境真值。
observation.en: Privately visible role/night information and public discussion history; inferred beliefs are not environment ground truth.

action.zh: 选择讨论策略并生成发言，最后提交投票对象；本评测夜间动作预先固定。
action.en: Select discussion tactics and generate utterances, then vote for a player; night actions are predefined in this evaluation.

metrics.zh: 各 Agent 配对下村民阵营的胜率矩阵，每个评测重复 30 次。
metrics.en: Team Village win-rate matrix for agent matchups, with 30 repetitions per evaluation.

controls.zh: Easy/Hard 两套角色和夜间动作；Hard 中强盗交换狼人身份；各阵营用同版代理，§6.3 用 Gemini 后端，temperature 1.0。
controls.en: Easy/Hard role/night configurations; Hard swaps a werewolf via the robber; each team uses one agent version, Section 6.3 uses Gemini with temperature 1.0.

limits.zh: 固定夜间设置的讨论评测，不等于随机角色的完整游戏覆盖；不把三人 NashConv 实验与五人胜率混算。
limits.en: Discussion evaluation under fixed nights, not full random-role coverage; three-player NashConv is not pooled with five-player win rate.

basis.zh: 语言陈述可真实或欺骗，需推断角色变化与他人意图以决定发言和投票。
basis.en: Statements may be truthful or deceptive; role changes and intentions guide speech and votes.

evidence.excerpt: Sections 6.1 and 6.3 evaluate five-player ONUW with predefined easy/hard roles and night actions, 30 repetitions and Team Village win-rate matrices.

basis.zh: 奖励取决于两人的序列是否符合相同约定。
basis.en: Reward depends on both sequences following a compatible convention.

evidence.title: Diverse Conventions for Human-AI Collaboration
evidence.excerpt: Section 4.1 and Appendix B.4 define alternating left/right choices, private action histories, convention-dependent terminal rewards and self/cross-play.

task.zh: 两位玩家选择兼容动作序列，获得 S 或更高的 G 终局奖励。
task.en: Two players choose compatible sequences for terminal reward S or the higher G.

observation.zh: 仅自己的历史动作；不能观察伙伴动作。
observation.en: Own action history; partner actions are hidden.

action.zh: 每步选择左 L 或右 R，各行动 k 步。
action.en: Choose L or R at each of k steps per player.

label.zh: 十轮重复囚徒困境的行为轨迹

task.zh: 与对手反复选择合作或背叛，观察交流与互惠行为。
task.en: Repeatedly cooperate or defect against an opponent and assess communication and reciprocity.

observation.zh: 已发生的对局与交流历史；双方知道十轮时限。
observation.en: Available play and communication history with a known ten-round horizon.

action.zh: 轮前交流，然后选择合作或背叛。

metrics.zh: 动作轨迹的合作率、条件互惠、报复率、宽恕率与末轮背叛；不采用动机自报作为真值。
metrics.en: Action-based cooperation, conditional reciprocity, retaliation, forgiveness and end-game defection; self-reported motives are not ground truth.

controls.zh: 限定论文展示的十轮重复博弈，示例配对为 LLaMA 3.1 70B 与 GPT-4o。

limits.zh: 不代表全部 24 个游戏；不合并存在配置歧义的评委打分。配对与重复次数须另行固定。
limits.en: Does not cover all 24 games or ambiguous judge-score configurations. Pairing and replication counts need explicit experimental settings.

basis.zh: 通过可观测合作与互惠轨迹检验社会互动，不推断内部动机。
basis.en: Observable cooperation and reciprocity trajectories measure social interaction without inferring internal motives.

task.zh: 在多个战场分配固定兵力，以赢得更多战场。
task.en: Allocate a fixed troop budget across battlefields to win more battlefields.

observation.zh: 规则、固定预算和已完成回合的结果；本轮对手分配隐藏。
observation.en: Rules, fixed budget and completed-round outcomes; current opponent allocation is hidden.

action.zh: 同时提交各战场的兵力分配。
action.en: Simultaneously submit allocations across battlefields.

metrics.zh: 对局胜负/TrueSkill，另报非法输入和分配错误。
metrics.en: Match outcomes/TrueSkill, with invalid input and allocation errors reported separately.

controls.zh: 双人零和，无通信；一轮重试后连续非法动作可致终止；比赛阶段分开。
controls.en: Two-player zero-sum, no communication; one retry before consecutive invalid actions can terminate play; tournament stages separated.

limits.zh: 具体预算、战场数与轮数需绑定提交版本，不能从其他 Blotto 实现继承。
limits.en: Budget, battlefield count and round count must be tied to the submitted version rather than inherited from other Blotto implementations.

basis.zh: 隐蔽同时分配要求对手建模与资源取舍。
basis.en: Hidden simultaneous allocation requires opponent modeling and resource trade-offs.

evidence.title: MINDGAMES: A Live Arena for Evaluating Social and Strategic Reasoning in Multi-Agent LLMs

task.zh: 间谍识别隐藏实体，非间谍通过问答发现间谍。
task.en: The spy identifies the hidden entity while non-spies identify the spy through questions.

observation.zh: 候选实体、角色私有信息与公开问答历史；间谍不见正确实体。
observation.en: Candidate entities, role-private information and public question history; the spy does not see the correct entity.

action.zh: 按阶段提问、回答、猜实体或投票，输出 JSON。
action.en: Issue phase-specific questions, answers, entity guesses or votes in JSON.

metrics.zh: 按角色和文化设置计算胜率及 Bradley–Terry 评分；格式失败单独处理。
metrics.en: Role/setting outcomes and Bradley–Terry ratings, with format failures handled separately.

controls.zh: 4 非间谍 + 1 间谍；前 5 轮问答、后 5 轮允许猜测和投票；角色排列与顺序控制。
controls.en: Four non-spies and one spy; five question rounds followed by five rounds permitting guesses and votes; role assignments and order controlled.

limits.zh: 仅核验该论文变体，非所有 Spyfall 规则；文化和语言知识影响成绩。
limits.en: Limited to this paper’s variant; cultural and linguistic knowledge affects performance.

basis.zh: 通过有限信息问答识别隐藏身份，同时管理信息泄露。
basis.en: Questioning under asymmetric information requires hidden-role inference and controlled disclosure.

evidence.title: Multicultural Spyfall: Assessing LLMs through Dynamic Multilingual Social Deduction Game
evidence.excerpt: The full paper specifies five-player Spyfall, a ten-turn schedule, strict JSON and terminal rules. Cultural knowledge and language proficiency remain confounds.

label.zh: 五人政府组建与隐藏身份推断
label.en: Five-player government formation and hidden-role inference

task.zh: 通过政府投票与政策执行争取阵营胜利。
task.en: Win the faction game through government votes and policy enactment.

observation.zh: 公共政策/投票历史、私有角色与政策手牌、讨论消息。
observation.en: Public policy/vote history, private role and policy cards, and discussion messages.

action.zh: 提名总理、投票、丢弃/执行政策及阶段内发言。
action.en: Nominate a chancellor, vote, discard/enact policies and speak within phases.

metrics.zh: 阵营胜率、角色识别准确率、欺骗保持率、政府通过率及局势影响指标。
metrics.en: Faction win rate, role-identification accuracy, deception retention, government approval and game-state impact.

controls.zh: 3 自由派、1 法西斯、1 希特勒；政府投票前和政策后各一轮随机顺序发言；固定与替代对手设置分开。
controls.en: Three liberals, one fascist and Hitler; randomized discussion before voting and after policies; fixed and alternative opponents reported separately.

limits.zh: 角色推断与局势影响是论文定义的辅助指标；不等同一般心理能力。
limits.en: Role inference and game-state impact are paper-defined auxiliary metrics, not general psychological ability.

basis.zh: 隐藏身份、公开辩论和投票直接检验身份推断与欺骗。
basis.en: Hidden identities, public debate and voting directly test role inference and deception.

basis.zh: 政策和政府选择影响阵营终局。
basis.en: Policy and government decisions affect faction outcomes.

evidence.title: Can Agents Deceive? Evaluating Reasoning and Deception in ParliamentBench using a Social Deduction Game
evidence.excerpt: Added the five-player role structure, government nomination/voting/policy phases and role-inference metrics; scope excludes other player counts.

task.zh: 扮演村民阵营或狼人阵营，通过发言、投票与角色行动取得阵营胜利。
task.en: Play a village or wolf role through speech, voting and role actions to achieve a team win.

observation.zh: 公开消息与按角色授权的私有信息。
observation.en: Public messages and role-authorized private information.

action.zh: 按状态提供 JSON 动作类型及参数：发言、投票、夜间击杀或角色技能。
action.en: State-dependent JSON action types and arguments for speech, voting, night kills and role abilities.

metrics.zh: 阵营胜负、按角色统计胜率；锦标赛结果经 Bradley–Terry MLE 得到 Elo。
metrics.en: Team outcomes and role-conditioned win rates; tournament outcomes feed Bradley–Terry MLE Elo.

controls.zh: 有限状态调度；40 轮上限；村民消灭狼人获胜，狼人达到人数平衡获胜。
controls.en: Finite-state scheduling, forty-turn cap, village victory on eliminating wolves and wolf victory at parity.

limits.zh: 这里只接入狼人杀，不把协议或能力复制给其余 20 个游戏；角色、配对与调度必须一致，Elo 依赖对手池。
limits.en: Only Werewolves is included, without propagating its protocol to the other twenty games. Match roles and scheduling; Elo depends on the opponent pool.

basis.zh: 隐藏角色与发言/投票策略由角色条件胜率评估。
basis.en: Hidden-role speech and voting decisions are evaluated with role-conditioned win rates.

evidence.title: Social Gym and SPaRTan, Appendix D and tournament evaluation
evidence.excerpt: Werewolves uses role-aware information and legal actions in a finite-state schedule with a forty-turn limit. Village wins by eliminating wolves; wolves win at parity. Tournament outcomes support role-conditioned win rates.

label.zh: 腐化通信下的阈值协作

task.zh: 在团队阈值收益条件下选择 STAG 或 HARE。
task.en: Choose STAG or HARE under threshold-dependent group payoffs.

observation.zh: 固定顺序的结构化公共历史与游戏规则。
observation.en: Structured public history in a fixed speaking order and game rules.

action.zh: 输出二元决策与理由；指定通道会翻转报告和执行动作。
action.en: Output a binary choice and justification; designated channels flip reported and executed actions.

metrics.zh: 原始 STAG 比例、翻转前成功率、实际成功率与福利差。
metrics.en: Original STAG fraction, pre-flip success, executed success and welfare gap.

controls.zh: 5 玩家、成功阈值 3；固定顺序；记录原始和翻转动作。
controls.en: Five players, success threshold three, fixed order, original and flipped decisions recorded.

limits.zh: 焦点配置没有匹配的零腐化对照；不能把福利差全部归因于自主策略改变。
limits.en: The focal configuration lacks a matched zero-corruption control; welfare gaps cannot all be attributed to autonomous strategy changes.

basis.zh: 回报依赖达到共同参与阈值。
basis.en: Payoffs depend on reaching a joint participation threshold.

evidence.title: Be Careful Who You Trust
evidence.excerpt: Distinguished original decisions from channel-flipped executed decisions and added the corrupted-channel Stag Hunt experiment; mechanical flips are not agent deception.

task.zh: 在合法国际象棋对局中争取胜利。
task.en: Win legal chess games.

observation.zh: FEN 与完整 PGN 历史，不提供合法着法列表。
observation.en: FEN and full PGN history without legal-move hints.

action.zh: 输出 SAN 着法。
action.en: Output a SAN move.

metrics.zh: Bradley–Terry Elo、bootstrap 区间和非法着法重试频率。
metrics.en: Bradley–Terry Elo, bootstrap intervals and illegal-move retry frequency.

controls.zh: 每对模型 40 局，白黑各 20；非法动作最多 3 次重试。
controls.en: Forty games per model pair, twenty per color; at most three invalid-move retries.

limits.zh: 内部 Elo 依赖参赛池；四次失败判负会混入格式可靠性。
limits.en: Internal Elo depends on the pool; four failures forfeit and conflate formatting reliability.

basis.zh: 对抗性着法选择以终局胜负评价。
basis.en: Adversarial move selection is evaluated by terminal outcomes.

task.en: Crewmates complete tasks or expel the impostor; the impostor prevents their success.

task.zh: 用有限试验识别生存机制并提交最终防御配置。
task.en: Use bounded experiments to identify survival mechanisms and submit a final defensive design.

observation.zh: 历史部署、生存/命中反馈、可查询环境变量；真实 SCM 隐藏。
observation.en: Deployment history, survival/hit feedback and queryable environment variables; true SCM hidden.

action.zh: 查询、部署候选配置、分析结果并一次性提交最终配置。
action.en: Query, deploy candidate designs, analyze results and submit a final design once.

metrics.zh: 最终 1000 架模拟机队生存率、75% 阈值成功；解释评分另列。
metrics.en: Survival of 1,000 simulated drones and success against a 75% threshold; explanation scores separate.

controls.zh: 固定天线陷阱因果机制；试验预算与工具次数按配置；终局不可重复提交。
controls.en: Fixed Antenna Trap causal mechanism; configured experiment/tool budgets; one terminal submission.

limits.zh: 信息获取/干预设计，不测低层飞行控制；预算不同不可直接比较。
limits.en: Information gathering and intervention design, not low-level flight control; different budgets are incomparable.

basis.zh: 主动干预和查询用于消除对隐藏因果机制的不确定性。
basis.en: Active interventions and queries reduce uncertainty about a hidden causal mechanism.

label.zh: 数独规则操作与组合泛化
label.en: Sudoku rule application and compositional generalization

task.zh: 按数独约束在网格中放置数值，解决需要组合策略的难题。
task.en: Place values under Sudoku constraints to solve puzzles requiring strategy composition.

observation.zh: 符号网格或由 MNIST 数字呈现的视觉线索网格。
observation.en: Symbolic grids or visual clue grids rendered with MNIST digits.

action.zh: place(row, col, value)，由规则校验并更新状态。
action.en: Rule-checked place(row, col, value) actions update the grid.

metrics.zh: Hard 难度任务的成功率，关联正确形成和应用所需策略。
metrics.en: Success rate on Hard tasks, assessing formation and application of required strategies.

controls.zh: 以 Easy/Moderate 训练，以含未见策略组合的 Hard 测试。
controls.en: Train on Easy/Moderate and evaluate Hard instances with unseen strategy combinations.

limits.zh: 仅接入已明确交互接口的数独；试题数、种子及动作预算尚未逐项锁定，不把静态问答当游玩。
limits.en: Includes the explicitly specified Sudoku interaction only. Instance counts, seeds and action budgets remain to be pinned down; static QA is not treated as gameplay.

basis.zh: 合法放置与解题成功检验数独约束应用。
basis.en: Legal placement and solving success assess Sudoku constraint application.

basis.zh: 测试要求组合训练阶段未共同出现的策略。
basis.en: Tests require combinations of strategies not jointly encountered in training.

evidence.title: ClassicLogic, Sections 3.5 and 4.4
evidence.excerpt: Sudoku provides rule-checked placement actions on grids. The compositional evaluation trains on Easy/Moderate instances and tests Hard instances requiring unseen strategy combinations, reporting success rates.

task.zh: 通过实验发现变换规则和每关未知目标。
task.en: Discover transformation rules and unknown level goals through experimentation.

observation.zh: 字符串状态、关卡、生命、步数、状态和合法动作。
observation.en: String state, level, lives, steps, status, and legal actions.

action.zh: 选择API动作，可切换宽松creative探索与survival模式。
action.en: Select API actions, including creative exploration and survival modes.

metrics.zh: 各难度层的通关比例与使用步数。
metrics.en: Win proportion by difficulty tier and action counts.

controls.zh: 固定生命/每关步数；有无规则提示作为消融；21公开与49私有区分。
controls.en: Fixed lives/steps, rules-given ablation, separate 21 public and 49 private games.

limits.zh: 难度按模型表现分层；只能把规则发现归于这个协议，不传播至任意谜题。
limits.en: Difficulty tiers depend on model performance; rule discovery is protocol-specific.

basis.zh: 未知机制要求主动试验并从反馈推断。
basis.en: Unknown mechanics require experimentation and inference from feedback.

basis.zh: 发现机制后使用有限步数完成关卡。
basis.en: After discovery, solve levels within limited steps.

basis.zh: 必须重建不可见的身份—位置绑定，oracle差距用于区分遗忘。

task.en: Integrate local views into topology and reach the maze goal.

observation.en: Egocentric views/history, no top-down map by default.

label.zh: Snake 严格规则闭环控制

task.zh: 在避开墙壁、身体和障碍物的同时吃苹果。
task.en: Eat apples while avoiding walls, the snake body and obstacles.

observation.zh: 网格中的墙、蛇头、身体、食物、障碍物及当前方向。
observation.en: Grid walls, head, body, food, obstacles and current direction.

action.zh: LEFT、RIGHT、UP、DOWN 四个方向动作；禁止反向。
action.en: LEFT, RIGHT, UP and DOWN, with reversal prohibited.

metrics.zh: 每个苹果加一分并增长；报告环境得分及学习曲线 Avg、Max、AUC+。
metrics.en: Each apple adds one point and increases length; report environment scores and curve Avg, Max and AUC+.

controls.zh: 严格评测遇碰撞终止、上限 64 步；30 次探索，每 3 次探索评测 3 局，评测种子分离且不反馈结果。
controls.en: Strict collision termination with a sixty-four-step cap; thirty exploration episodes, three evaluation games every three episodes, disjoint seeds and no evaluation feedback.

limits.zh: 仅覆盖 Snake；探索时碰撞为 no-op 与严格评测不同，曲线汇总并非独立能力。
limits.en: Covers Snake only. Exploration collision no-ops differ from strict evaluation; curve aggregates are not separate capabilities.

basis.zh: 方向选择、避碰与得分直接检验闭环控制。
basis.en: Direction selection, collision avoidance and score directly assess closed-loop control.

basis.zh: 分离种子及更严格终止规则检验同一游戏内的转移。
basis.en: Disjoint seeds and stricter termination test within-game transfer.

evidence.title: S3Gym, Table 2 and Appendix A.4
evidence.excerpt: Snake exposes a grid and four directional moves. Apples add score and length. Strict evaluation terminates on collisions and forbids reversal; the step cap is sixty-four. Exploration and evaluation use disjoint seeds.

task.zh: 描述者避免目标词及禁词，帮助猜词者识别目标。
task.en: A describer avoids the target and forbidden words while helping a guesser identify the concept.

observation.zh: 描述者见目标和禁词；猜词者只见合法描述与对话。
observation.en: The describer sees the target and taboo words; the guesser sees valid descriptions and dialogue.

action.zh: 生成描述或目标词猜测。
action.en: Generate a description or a target-word guess.

metrics.zh: 有效进行比例、成功时 100/n 的速度分及两者组合的 clemscore。
metrics.en: Played ratio, successful speed score 100/n, and their combined clemscore.

controls.zh: 最多三轮猜词；Game Master 严格解析并检查禁词。

value.zh: 当前画面及可用动作；可检索历史帧、像素和代理自己的笔记。
value.en: Current image and available actions, with optional historical frames, pixel inspection and agent notes.

sources.title: VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an Interactive World
sources.excerpt: Section 4 evaluates twenty-five public ARC-AGI-3 games with undisclosed rules/goals, image observations, available actions, level completion and relative human action efficiency.

value.zh: play执行环境提供的动作；inspect/read_pixels为观察工具。
value.en: play executes available environment actions; inspect/read_pixels provide observations.

sources.title: VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an Interactive World
sources.excerpt: Section 4 evaluates twenty-five public ARC-AGI-3 games with undisclosed rules/goals, image observations, available actions, level completion and relative human action efficiency.

value.zh: RHAE、完成游戏比例与动作总数；未完成关卡记零。
value.en: RHAE, game completion fraction and total actions; unfinished levels receive zero.

sources.title: VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an Interactive World
sources.excerpt: Section 4 evaluates twenty-five public ARC-AGI-3 games with undisclosed rules/goals, image observations, available actions, level completion and relative human action efficiency.

value.zh: 仅论文25个公开游戏；保持相同harness，模型推理强度、视觉表示和上下文预算分别报告。
value.en: Only the twenty-five public games; fix harness and report model effort, visual representation and context budget separately.

sources.title: VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an Interactive World
sources.excerpt: Section 4 evaluates twenty-five public ARC-AGI-3 games with undisclosed rules/goals, image observations, available actions, level completion and relative human action efficiency.

value.zh: 探索映射依据全套公开任务明确未给出的规则/目标，不给各游戏复制记忆、规划等其他能力；不含静态BabyVision。
value.en: Exploration follows the explicitly undisclosed goals/rules of this public task set; no copied memory/planning labels per game; static BabyVision excluded.

sources.title: VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an Interactive World
sources.excerpt: Section 4 evaluates twenty-five public ARC-AGI-3 games with undisclosed rules/goals, image observations, available actions, level completion and relative human action efficiency.

task.zh: 试探反馈并提交满足未知规则的路径。
task.en: Probe feedback and submit paths obeying hidden rules.

observation.zh: ASCII 网格、路径、反馈和局内规则记事本。
observation.en: ASCII board, path, feedback and within-game rule notebook.

action.zh: 四向移动、SUBMIT、RESET；每调用最多 16 动作。
action.en: Four moves, SUBMIT, RESET; at most 16 actions per call.

metrics.zh: RHAE-L5/L20、完成关卡数、相对最优动作效率。
metrics.en: RHAE-L5/L20, solved levels and optimal-action efficiency.

controls.zh: 每关 300 动作、每游戏 1,000 调用；测试 5 种子，验证 3 种子；区分提供规则的消融。
controls.en: 300 actions per level, 1,000 calls per game; 5 test and 3 validation seeds; separate rule-revealed ablation.

limits.zh: 17 个私有测试游戏不应复制到四个公开示例；失败可能来自解析、发现或执行。
limits.en: Do not copy 17 private-test results to four public examples; failure may arise from parsing, discovery or execution.

basis.zh: 动作反馈用于检验隐藏规则假设。
basis.en: Action feedback tests hidden-rule hypotheses.

basis.zh: 验证明确区分新规则组合和新规则原语。
basis.en: Validation separates novel rule combinations and unseen primitives.

task.zh: 根据激光反馈定位隐藏球
task.en: Infer hidden balls from laser feedback

observation.zh: 棋盘内部离散状态；可选 RGB 像素。
observation.en: Discrete board state; optional RGB pixels.

action.zh: 该游戏的离散键盘动作；具体键位见附录 E 表 5。
action.en: Puzzle-specific discrete keyboard actions; Appendix E Table 5.

metrics.zh: 完成率、成功回合步数；参考人类与最优步数上界。
metrics.en: Completion rate and successful episode length; human and optimal-step upper-bound references.

controls.zh: 固定难度与尺寸；5 个训练种子，每策略 1,000 测试局；10,000 步上限；报告观察、mask 与奖励配置。
controls.en: Fix difficulty and size; 5 training seeds, 1,000 evaluation episodes per policy, 10,000-step cap; report observation, masks and rewards.

limits.zh: 规则推理与接口操作共同影响成绩；不单独证明记忆、实时控制或长时程能力。
limits.en: Scores combine rule reasoning and interface actions; they do not isolate memory, real-time control or long-horizon competence.

basis.zh: 通过主动试探反馈消除隐藏配置的假设。
basis.en: Active probes reduce uncertainty about the hidden configuration.

basis.zh: 任务目标为“根据激光反馈定位隐藏球”；完成率衡量在规则约束下得到有效解，归类为任务关联而非隔离的推理因果测量。
basis.en: The objective is to infer hidden balls from laser feedback. Completion measures a valid rule-constrained solution; this is a task association, not an isolated causal reasoning measurement.

task.en: Fill a two-colour grid without triples

metrics.zh: 完成率、成功回合步数；参考人类与最优步数上界。

limits.zh: 规则推理与接口操作共同影响成绩；不单独证明记忆、实时控制或长时程能力。

action.en: Choose one engine-permitted discrete action per step

controls.zh: 此单位限定§4.2–4.3六游戏跨模型比较，零样本与上下文提示分开；118游戏GPT-4o-mini初筛另属更广范围。
controls.en: This unit is scoped to the six-game cross-model comparison in Sections 4.2–4.3, separating zero-shot/contextual prompts; the 118-game GPT-4o-mini sweep has broader scope.

limits.zh: 集合指标不独立分离九项能力；待逐游戏任务审查后再细分能力

evidence.title: GVGAI-LLM: Evaluating Large Language Model Agents with Infinite Games
evidence.excerpt: Verified textual interaction and behavior metrics across 118 games; the default per-step setup supplies no history and is not labelled a memory evaluation.

label.zh: Sokoban / RealSokoban 空间推箱规划

task.zh: 根据墙、箱子和目标的位置安排推动顺序，避免不可逆死锁并完成推箱目标。
task.en: Plan pushes from wall, box and goal positions, avoid irreversible deadlocks and solve the box-pushing level.

observation.zh: ASCII状态、实体映射、目标、动作映射；默认不含过去状态动作
observation.en: ASCII state, entity/goal/action mappings; no past states/actions by default

action.zh: 每步选择引擎允许的离散动作
action.en: Choose one engine-permitted discrete action per step

metrics.zh: 两款各自的胜率、归一化奖励、有效动作比例和步效率；不将共同综合分解释为独立规划分。
metrics.en: Per-game win rate, normalized reward, meaningful-step ratio and efficiency; aggregate scores are not independent planning scores.

controls.zh: 分开程序生成Sokoban与人工XSokoban关卡的RealSokoban；九LLM零样本/上下文提示条件分开，沿用原文逐关卡重复与统计区间。
controls.en: Separate procedurally generated Sokoban from RealSokoban’s human-designed XSokoban levels; keep nine-model zero-shot/contextual settings and the paper’s per-level repetitions/intervals separate.

limits.zh: 仅两种GVGAI推箱实现；空间与规划是规则和死锁机制支持的编辑归类，成功率也受状态识别与动作格式影响；不复制给其他116款。
limits.en: Only the two GVGAI box-pushing implementations. Spatial/planning labels are editorial classifications grounded in rules and deadlocks; perception/formatting also affect success. Other 116 games do not inherit them.

basis.zh: 表3将二者列为空间谜题；需要推断箱、墙、目标的相对位置和移动可达性。
basis.en: Table 3 identifies both as spatial puzzles requiring reasoning about box/wall/goal relations and movement feasibility.

basis.zh: §4.2明确不可逆移动和死锁要求多步推箱次序，人工RealSokoban通常规划更长。
basis.en: Section 4.2 describes irreversible moves and deadlock-sensitive push ordering, with longer planning demands in human-designed RealSokoban.

label.zh: Craftax 生存与地下城进展

task.zh: 维持生存资源，制作工具、战斗并逐层推进地下城。
task.en: Maintain survival resources, craft tools, fight and progress through dungeon floors.

observation.zh: 局部符号地图、物品栏、生存资源和楼层状态。
observation.en: Local symbolic map, inventory, intrinsic resources and floor indicators.

action.zh: 移动、交互、制作、装备与上下楼等环境离散动作。
action.en: Discrete movement, interaction, crafting, equipment and floor traversal.

metrics.zh: 官方轨道以累计奖励占最大值 226 的百分比报告。
metrics.en: Official tracks report cumulative reward as a percentage of 226.

controls.zh: 分别记录 1M 与 1B 交互预算；固定版本、观测及重置设置。
controls.en: Keep 1M and 1B interaction tracks separate; fix version, observations and resets.

limits.zh: 综合奖励不分离单项能力；该节点也含 Classic 名称，但本单位仅适用于扩展 Craftax。
limits.en: Aggregate reward does not isolate abilities; this unit applies only to extended Craftax despite the combined index label.

basis.zh: 跨楼层推进依赖持续生存和多阶段装备升级。
basis.en: Cross-floor progression requires sustained survival and staged equipment upgrades.

basis.zh: 工具制作存在木材、石材、铁矿等先决依赖。
basis.en: Crafting has resource and tool prerequisites.

basis.zh: 必须发现资源和通往下一层的入口。
basis.en: Resources and exits must be discovered.

task.en: Collect weapons and return them, balancing reward, load and return timing.

observation.en: 160×120 egocentric RGB with HUD and 90-degree horizontal field of view.

action.en: Simplified forward, left/right turn, use and jump actions.

metrics.zh: 武器交付回报与累计超载代价，按安全阈值约束比较。
metrics.en: Delivery return and cumulative overload cost under a safety threshold.

controls.zh: 随机初态、最多 2,100 ticks；固定难度、代价预算和动作版本。
controls.en: Random starts, up to 2,100 ticks; fix difficulty, cost budget and action variant.

task.zh: 从画面判断情况并操作游戏，推进预设关卡检查点。
task.en: Operate from visual observations and advance predefined level checkpoints.

observation.zh: 原始屏幕帧与目标/操作说明；无 RAM、解析状态或中间奖励。
observation.en: Raw frames and objective/control instructions; no RAM, parsed state or intermediate rewards.

metrics.zh: 到达检查点占该游戏全部检查点的比例。
metrics.en: Fraction of the game's predefined checkpoints reached.

controls.zh: 固定起点、游戏时限和重启规则；区分持续运行与推理时暂停的 Lite。
controls.en: Fix start, time cap and restart rules; distinguish real-time running from paused-inference Lite.

limits.zh: Doom II 的具体时限/检查点清单需随发布配置锁定；Lite 不测相同实时延迟约束。
limits.en: Pin Doom II's exact cap/checkpoint list to the release; Lite removes real-time inference pressure.

basis.zh: 动作持续时间、瞄准与移动直接影响关卡推进。
basis.en: Action timing, aiming and movement directly affect level progression.

task.en: Manage Protoss economy, technology and army against built-in Zerg AI.

basis.en: Full games require economic, composition and attack/defense tradeoffs.

basis.zh: 生产与科技路径存在前置依赖。
basis.en: Production and technology paths have prerequisites.

basis.zh: 目标跨整局维持并随对手调整。
basis.en: Objectives must persist and adapt throughout a full game.

task.zh: 在收集资源与清理公共河流之间取舍，并适应不同伙伴行为。
task.en: Balance resource harvesting and public river cleaning with different co-players.

observation.zh: 局部 RGB 和配置允许的局部状态；不向策略提供 WORLD.RGB 等调试全局状态。
observation.en: Local RGB and allowed local state; exclude global debug observations such as WORLD.RGB.

action.zh: 移动、转向、清理与 zap 等离散动作。
action.en: Discrete movement, turn, clean and zap actions.

metrics.zh: 焦点 Agent 的人均回报；比赛分数相对基线最好/最差回报归一化。
metrics.en: Focal per-capita return; contest score normalized to baseline best/worst returns.

controls.zh: 公开验证场景 clean_up_2–8；最终比赛另有留出伙伴，按官方场景版本固定。
controls.en: Public validation clean_up_2–8; final contest has held-out partners; pin official scenario versions.

limits.zh: 只展开 Clean Up；当前公开配置不宣称等同隐藏最终测试。高分不自动证明亲社会性。
limits.en: Only Clean Up is expanded; current public configs are not the hidden final test. High score is not automatically prosociality.

basis.zh: 评测对训练未见伙伴群体的适应。
basis.en: Evaluates adaptation to co-player populations not seen in training.

basis.zh: 清理公共资源与个人采集之间的社会困境。
basis.en: Public cleaning and private harvesting create a social dilemma.

label.zh: Clean Up 社会情境泛化

task.zh: 共同维护河流以维持可采集资源，面对陌生伙伴调整采集与清理行为。
task.en: Sustain harvestable resources by maintaining the river while adapting to unfamiliar partners.

observation.zh: 各 Agent 的局部像素与个体奖励；不是完整全局状态。
observation.en: Individual local pixels and rewards, not full global state.

action.zh: 移动、转向、采集以及清理河流等交互动作。
action.en: Movement, turning, harvesting and river-cleaning interactions.

metrics.zh: 仅焦点群体的人均累计回报，排除背景 Agent；按测试场景报告。
metrics.en: Focal per-capita return excluding background agents, reported by scenario.

controls.zh: 原实验每 substrate 训练 1B 步；固定焦点/背景采样比例、背景策略与配置版本。
controls.en: Original experiments train 1B steps per substrate; fix population mix, background policies and configuration version.

limits.zh: 与竞赛条目共用底层游戏；不能重复算作两个独立游戏。回报并非独立道德判断量表。
limits.en: Shares a game with the contest, not two independent games. Return is not a standalone moral judgment scale.

basis.zh: 陌生背景策略组成明确测试情境。
basis.en: Unfamiliar background policies define test situations.

basis.zh: 个人采集收益依赖其他 Agent 对公共河流的维护。
basis.en: Private harvesting relies on others maintaining the public river.

basis.zh: 采集与清理活动需要形成可持续的群体分工。
basis.en: Harvesting and cleaning require sustainable division of labor.

task.zh: 翻开牌并匹配点数或颜色，利用先前见过的位置。
task.en: Reveal and match ranks or colors using previously seen positions.

observation.zh: 牌位数组：只显示已匹配或当前翻开的值，其余隐藏。

action.zh: 选择一个牌位索引翻牌。

metrics.zh: 每匹配得归一化奖励；失败/重复翻已开牌受惩罚，汇总回报。
metrics.en: Normalized match reward with failure/already-open penalties; aggregate return.

controls.zh: 固定牌组数、匹配类型、洗牌种子和由牌数决定的 episode_length。
controls.en: Fix deck count, matching type, shuffle seeds and deck-size-dependent episode_length.

basis.zh: 盖回的牌值需要凭历史观测与位置关联检索。
basis.en: Hidden-again values must be retrieved by associating history with positions.

label.zh: 原始 ALE：三款代表游戏的得分评测
label.en: Original ALE: score evaluation on three representative games

task.zh: 完成重置后的 Atari 游戏回合并最大化原生游戏得分。
task.en: Play Atari episodes after reset and maximize native game score.

observation.zh: 160×210 游戏屏幕；论文也比较 RAM 特征表示。
observation.en: 160×210 game screen; the paper also compares RAM-based features.

action.zh: 18 种摇杆与按键组合；论文每 5 帧选一次动作。
action.en: 18 joystick/button combinations; action selection every five frames in the paper.

metrics.zh: 500 个不学习的评估回合平均分，再对 30 次试验汇总。
metrics.en: Mean score over 500 non-learning evaluation episodes, aggregated across 30 trials.

controls.zh: 每次先训练 5,000 回合；终局或 18,000 帧结束；Asterix、Seaquest 属参数调优游戏，Boxing 属测试游戏。
controls.en: 5,000 training episodes per trial; termination at game over or 18,000 frames; Asterix and Seaquest are tuning games and Boxing is a test game.

limits.zh: 仅为原始论文的三款代表游戏；不等同后续 ALE-57、sticky-action 或人类归一化协议，也不是零样本跨游戏迁移。
limits.en: Only three representative games from the original paper; not later ALE-57, sticky-action or human-normalized protocols, and not zero-shot cross-game transfer.

basis.zh: 根据逐帧反馈控制移动、攻击与躲避，以游戏得分评价。
basis.en: Movement, attacking and avoidance are controlled from frame feedback and evaluated by game score.

label.zh: SMAC 分散执行的协作微操

task.zh: 每个智能体控制一个作战单位，协同击败内置敌军；使用论文 14 个微操场景。
task.en: Each agent controls one unit and cooperates to defeat built-in enemies across the paper’s 14 micromanagement scenarios.

observation.zh: 单位视野内队友/敌军相对位置、生命、护盾与类型等局部特征；全局状态仅供集中训练。
observation.en: Local allied/enemy relative positions, health, shields and types within sight; global state is available only for centralized training.

action.zh: 四方向移动、按敌军 ID 攻击、停止；医疗运输机治疗队友；死亡单位 no-op。
action.en: Move in four directions, attack an enemy ID or stop; Medivacs heal allies; dead units use no-op.

metrics.zh: 在场景时限内击败所有敌人的 test win rate；训练曲线汇总中位数。
metrics.en: Test win rate for defeating every enemy within the scenario limit; training curves report medians.

controls.zh: 每 10,000 训练时间步暂停，运行 32 个贪心分散执行测试回合；固定场景、奖励设置与 SC2 版本。
controls.en: Pause every 10,000 training timesteps for 32 greedy decentralized test episodes; fix scenario, reward settings and SC2 version.

limits.zh: 仅微操战斗，不包含全局经济运营、建筑发展或语言沟通；训练使用的密集奖励与最终胜率需区分。
limits.en: Combat micromanagement only; no full-game economy, construction or language communication; shaped training rewards differ from evaluation win rate.

basis.zh: 单位必须在局部观测和分散执行下协同集火、走位或治疗。
basis.en: Units coordinate targeting, positioning or healing under local observations and decentralized execution.

basis.zh: 移动与攻击距离、冷却和走位共同影响战斗结果。
basis.en: Movement, attack range, cooldowns and positioning affect combat outcome.

task.en: Start from a limited base, gather resources, build supply depots and barracks, and produce as many marines as possible within the limit.

controls.zh: 固定小游戏时限和最小任务动作集；原论文 A3C 每 8 游戏步决策，实验训练 600M agent steps。

basis.zh: 生产陆战队员需要遵循资源、补给和兵营的前置依赖。

label.en: BabyAI: relational placement and composite instructions

task.zh: 执行 PutNextLocal 的物体相邻放置指令及 BossLevel 的多步组合指令，包含拾取、开门与到达。
task.en: Execute PutNextLocal object-adjacency instructions and BossLevel composite instructions involving pickup, opening doors and reaching objects.

observation.zh: 指令文本与朝向前方的 7×7×3 符号格子观测；墙和关闭的门遮挡视野。
observation.en: Instruction text and forward-facing 7×7×3 symbolic grid observations; walls and closed doors occlude visibility.

action.zh: 左/右转、前进、拾取、放下、toggle、done。
action.en: Turn left/right, move forward, pick up, drop, toggle and done.

metrics.zh: 指令完成成功率；达到至少 99% 成功率所需示范数或 RL 回合数衡量样本效率。
metrics.en: Instruction success rate; demonstrations or RL episodes needed to reach at least 99% success measure sample efficiency.

controls.zh: 使用生成器指定关卡和任务步数上限；论文验证使用 512 回合；奖励随成功所用步数折扣。
controls.en: Use the specified level generator and mission step limit; paper validation uses 512 episodes; successful reward decreases with steps used.

limits.zh: 合成语言和符号观测；不证明自然语言开放世界泛化。这里只有两个指令任务族，不能替代全部 BabyAI 关卡。
limits.en: Synthetic language and symbolic observations do not establish natural-language open-world generalization; only two task families are registered.

basis.zh: 复合指令涉及顺序约束、钥匙/门前置条件和目标分解。
basis.en: Composite instructions require ordering constraints, key/door prerequisites and goal decomposition.

basis.zh: PutNextLocal 必须使指定物体形成相邻关系。
basis.en: PutNextLocal requires a specified adjacency relation between objects.

evidence.title: BabyAI: A Platform to Study the Sample Efficiency of Grounded Language Learning
evidence.excerpt: Figure 1, learning experiments and Appendix B specify PutNextLocal/BossLevel instruction execution, egocentric 7×7 symbolic observations, seven actions and success/sample-efficiency metrics.

label.zh: OpenSpiel：双人 Leduc Poker 策略评估
label.en: OpenSpiel: two-player Leduc Poker policy evaluation

task.zh: 在部分信息牌局中通过自博弈学习下注策略，并评估策略偏离均衡的程度。
task.en: Learn betting policies by self-play in imperfect-information poker and evaluate departure from equilibrium.

observation.zh: 玩家的信息状态，包括自己的私人牌与可观察的公共下注/发牌历史；不读取对手私人牌。
observation.en: Player information states include private cards and observable public betting/dealing history, excluding opponents’ private cards.

action.zh: 从当前合法的牌局动作中选择下注、跟注/过牌或弃牌等。
action.en: Choose from currently legal poker actions such as betting, calling/checking and folding.

metrics.zh: Exploitability 或 NashConv（筹码单位）随训练回合/迭代的变化。
metrics.en: Exploitability or NashConv in chips against training episodes/iterations.

controls.zh: 限定双人 Leduc 规则；图 3 汇总各算法最佳五组种子/超参数，图 4 使用表格算法比较。
controls.en: Fix two-player Leduc rules; Figure 3 averages the top five seed/hyperparameter settings, while Figure 4 compares tabular algorithms.

limits.zh: 平台示范性算法评估，非 OpenSpiel 全游戏统一基准；最佳配置选择有报告偏差风险，不能与随机种子平均数混用。
limits.en: An illustrative platform algorithm evaluation, not a unified OpenSpiel benchmark; selected best configurations must not be confused with averages over arbitrary seeds.

basis.zh: 下注策略必须考虑隐藏牌与对手反应，且以可利用度衡量。
basis.en: Betting policies account for hidden cards and opponent responses and are evaluated by exploitability.

evidence.title: OpenSpiel: A Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Games
evidence.excerpt: Sections 3.1–3.3 and Figures 3–4 report two-player Leduc poker policy learning and exploitability/NashConv in chips; these are concrete examples rather than a single platform-wide score.

value.en: Learn betting policies by self-play in imperfect-information poker and evaluate departure from equilibrium.

label.zh: DeepMind Lab：随机迷宫探索与返航
label.en: DeepMind Lab: random-maze exploration and revisiting

task.zh: 每回合探索新生成的迷宫，找到目标后重复导航返回目标以累计奖励。
task.en: Explore a newly generated maze each episode, locate the goal and repeatedly navigate back for reward.

observation.zh: 第一视角 RGB 像素与奖励；RGBD 和速度是平台可选接口，必须按实验显式指定。
observation.en: First-person RGB pixels and reward; RGBD and velocity are optional platform interfaces that must be specified per experiment.

action.zh: 前进/后退、侧移、蹲下/跳跃及两轴视角控制；接口按仿真步同步。
action.en: Forward/backward movement, strafing, crouch/jump and two-axis look controls through a lock-stepped interface.

metrics.zh: 三分钟回合内累计关卡奖励，反映反复到达目标的表现。
metrics.en: Cumulative level reward within a three-minute episode, reflecting repeated goal reaching.

controls.zh: 每回合重新生成迷宫；固定关卡、随机种子、观测模式、仿真帧率和动作重复设置。
controls.en: Regenerate the maze each episode; fix level, seeds, observation mode, simulation frame rate and action repetition.

limits.zh: 论文定义了任务和奖励，但未给此任务一套通用训练预算/种子排行榜；作为平台代表协议，未覆盖所有 Lab 关卡。
limits.en: The paper defines the task and reward but not a universal training-budget/seed leaderboard; this is one representative platform protocol.

basis.zh: 目标和新迷宫布局需通过探索发现。
basis.en: The goal and new maze layout must be discovered by exploration.

basis.zh: 找到目标后需利用本回合已学布局再次返回。
basis.en: After finding the goal, the agent must reuse the layout learned in that episode.

basis.zh: 第一视角导航要求利用迷宫的空间连通关系。
basis.en: Egocentric navigation requires spatial connectivity of the maze.

evidence.excerpt: The platform interface and example-level sections specify random_maze: a new maze each episode, explore then repeatedly return to the goal within three minutes; observations are first-person pixels and actions are movement/look controls.

label.zh: GVGAI：未知游戏的单人规划赛道
label.en: GVGAI: single-player planning on unseen games

task.zh: 在不读取 VGDL 规则文件的情况下，对未公开游戏/关卡逐步选择动作，争取获胜和高分。
task.en: Choose actions in withheld games/levels without access to VGDL rule files, aiming to win and score highly.

observation.zh: 游戏时间、得分、胜负、角色位置/资源/生命、碰撞历史与各类精灵位置；提供可复制和推进的前向模型。
observation.en: Time, score, winner, avatar position/resources/health, collision history and sprite positions; a copyable forward model supports simulation.

action.zh: 从游戏当前可用动作选择一个动作；规划中可调用前向模型模拟动作。
action.en: Select one available game action; planning can simulate actions through the forward model.

metrics.zh: 先按胜率、再按得分和游戏长度排序；逐游戏排名积分汇总确定赛道排名。
metrics.en: Order agents by victory rate, then score and game length; aggregate per-game ranking points.

controls.zh: 每组 10 游戏、每游戏 5 关；1 秒初始化、每 tick 40 ms，40–50 ms 罚 no-op、超过 50 ms 取消资格。
controls.en: Ten games per set with five levels each; one-second initialization, 40 ms per tick, no-op penalty at 40–50 ms and disqualification above 50 ms.

limits.zh: 限定原论文单人 planning 赛道；不混入无前向模型的 learning 赛道或生成赛道。具体私有测试游戏随赛季变化。
limits.en: Limited to the paper’s single-player planning track, excluding model-free learning and generation tracks; private test games vary by season.

basis.zh: 可调用前向模型搜索行动后果，在实时预算内选择动作。
basis.en: The forward model supports searching action consequences within a real-time budget.

basis.zh: 最终排名在与公开训练集分开的私有游戏集合上计算。
basis.en: Final rankings use private game sets separate from public training games.

label.zh: Obstacle Tower：跨地图与外观的爬塔
label.en: Obstacle Tower: traversal across layouts and visual themes

task.zh: 穿越程序生成楼层，解锁门和谜题、避开障碍，在死亡或时间耗尽前攀登尽可能多的楼层。
task.en: Traverse procedural floors, unlock doors/solve puzzles and avoid hazards to complete as many floors as possible before death or timeout.

observation.zh: 第三视角 RGB（168×168 或缩至 84×84），外加钥匙数量和剩余时间。
observation.en: Third-person RGB at 168×168 or downsampled 84×84, plus key count and remaining time.

action.zh: 前后、左右移动、旋转镜头和跳跃的多离散动作，也可展平为 54 个动作。
action.en: Multidiscrete forward/backward, lateral movement, camera rotation and jump, optionally flattened to 54 actions.

metrics.zh: 每回合完成楼层数的均值/离散程度；稀疏奖励每过一层 +1，密集奖励另奖开门/拿钥匙/解谜。
metrics.en: Mean/distribution of floors completed per episode; sparse reward is +1 per floor, with additional dense rewards for doors, keys and puzzles.

controls.zh: 弱泛化：100 个训练种子、5 个未见测试种子、5 次 agent 随机重复；强泛化另留出视觉主题。
controls.en: Weak generalization: 100 training seeds, five unseen test seeds and five agent-randomness repetitions; strong generalization also holds out a visual theme.

limits.zh: 论文实测原型最高 25 层；不能把未来 100 层环境当作已评测结果。固定奖励模式和视觉主题以保证可比。
limits.en: The evaluated prototype has at most 25 floors; the proposed 100-floor environment is not an evaluated result. Reward mode and visual themes must be fixed.

basis.zh: 以未见地图种子和视觉主题专门检验迁移。
basis.en: Held-out layout seeds and visual themes explicitly test transfer.

basis.zh: 跳跃、转向和避障决定是否继续爬塔。
basis.en: Jumping, steering and hazard avoidance determine survival.

basis.zh: 钥匙、锁门与谜题产生任务先后依赖。
basis.en: Keys, locked doors and puzzles create prerequisite dependencies.

task.zh: 在森林出生并持有铁斧，收集 64 单位木材或到达任务终止条件。
task.en: Spawn in a forest with an iron axe and collect 64 wood units before termination.

observation.zh: 基线使用缩放至 64×64 的灰度画面；Navigate 另提供指向目标附近位置的指南针。
observation.en: Baselines use 64×64 grayscale frames; Navigate additionally provides a compass toward a position near the goal.

action.zh: 原生键鼠/制作动作在基线中映射为 10 个离散动作原语。
action.en: Native keyboard/mouse/crafting actions are mapped to ten discrete action primitives for the baselines.

metrics.zh: 每收集 1 木材奖励 +1；报告最佳连续 100 回合平均奖励及标准差。
metrics.en: Reward +1 per wood unit; report the best contiguous 100-episode mean reward and standard deviation.

controls.zh: 原论文 RL 训练 1,500 回合（约 12M 帧）；固定任务变体、示范使用和动作映射。
controls.en: Original RL training uses 1,500 episodes (about 12M frames); fix task variant, demonstration use and action mapping.

limits.zh: 最佳训练窗口得分不是独立留出测试；这里只计论文实际在线实验，不把整个示范库或 ObtainDiamond 都算已运行。
limits.en: Best training-window scores are not independent held-out tests; only actual online experiments are counted, not the whole demonstration corpus or ObtainDiamond.

basis.zh: 需靠视觉瞄准、移动和连续砍伐获得木材。
basis.en: Visual aiming, movement and repeated chopping are needed to obtain wood.

task.zh: 穿过程序生成地形到达约 64 格外目标；指南针指向近似位置，最后仍需视觉搜索。
task.en: Traverse procedural terrain to a goal about 64 blocks away; the compass gives an approximate position and final localization requires visual search.

observation.zh: 基线使用缩放至 64×64 的灰度画面；Navigate 另提供指向目标附近位置的指南针。
observation.en: Baselines use 64×64 grayscale frames; Navigate additionally provides a compass toward a position near the goal.

action.zh: 原生键鼠/制作动作在基线中映射为 10 个离散动作原语。
action.en: Native keyboard/mouse/crafting actions are mapped to ten discrete action primitives for the baselines.

metrics.zh: 最佳连续 100 回合平均回报；稀疏版仅到达奖励，密集版另按接近目标的距离给奖励；两版分别报告。
metrics.en: Best contiguous 100-episode mean return; sparse rewards are for arrival, while dense rewards also track progress toward the goal; variants are reported separately.

controls.zh: 原论文 RL 训练 1,500 回合（约 12M 帧）；固定任务变体、示范使用和动作映射。
controls.en: Original RL training uses 1,500 episodes (about 12M frames); fix task variant, demonstration use and action mapping.

limits.en: Best training-window scores are not independent held-out tests; only actual online experiments are counted, not the whole demonstration corpus or ObtainDiamond.

basis.zh: 需结合指南针方向与非凸地形，选择可行路线到达目标。
basis.en: Compass direction and nonconvex terrain must be combined to find a feasible route.

basis.zh: 指南针位置与真实终点存在偏移，需要局部搜索。
basis.en: The compass target is offset from the actual goal, requiring local search.

task.zh: 推动箱子到目标位置；所有箱子完成时满足胜利条件，避免把箱子推入不可恢复布局。
task.en: Push boxes onto targets; all boxes completed satisfy the win condition, while irreversible deadlocks must be avoided.

observation.zh: Vector、Block、Sprite 三种关卡表示；此处仅接入表 1 的逐关卡实验。
observation.en: Vector, Block and Sprite level representations; this unit covers only the per-level experiments in Table 1.

action.zh: 完整可观测实验使用 no-op、上、左、下、右五动作；推进箱子由移动交互触发。
action.en: Fully observable experiments use no-op, up, left, down and right; movement interactions push boxes.

metrics.zh: 每关训练结束前最后 100 回合的平均奖励及离散程度；按关卡和观测类型分别报告。
metrics.en: Mean reward and dispersion over the final 100 training episodes, reported separately by level and observer type.

controls.zh: 每关 1.28M 步，PPO 与 RND；固定关卡、观察器、奖励配置和随机种子。
controls.en: 1.28M steps per level using PPO with RND; fix level, observer, reward configuration and seeds.

limits.zh: 平台实现的代表任务，不等同所有 Sokoban 变体；未把表 2 中存在划分文字歧义的泛化协议并入此单位。
limits.en: A representative platform implementation, not all Sokoban variants; the generalization protocol with ambiguous split wording in Table 2 is excluded.

basis.zh: 箱子推移不可随意撤销，需提前规划目标顺序。
basis.en: Box pushes cannot be freely undone, requiring advance planning of target order.

basis.zh: 墙、箱子与目标的空间关系决定可达性和死锁。
basis.en: Spatial relations among walls, boxes and targets determine reachability and deadlocks.

task.zh: 采集资源、建造设施与部队，摧毁对手基地，分别迎战 SIMPLE 与 HIT N RUN 规则 AI。
task.en: Gather resources, construct facilities/units and destroy the opponent’s base against SIMPLE and HIT N RUN rule-based AIs.

observation.zh: 20×20 多通道空间特征表示可见单位类型/生命与资源；战争迷雾限制信息，但对手基地位置已知。
observation.en: 20×20 multichannel spatial features encode visible unit types/health and resources; fog of war limits information but the enemy base location is known.

action.zh: 9 个全局策略宏动作，具体工人选择/建筑放置等由硬编码执行器完成。
action.en: Nine global strategic macro-actions with hard-coded execution such as worker selection and construction placement.

metrics.zh: 对内置对手的胜率；终局胜/负奖励 +1/−1，报告重复训练的均值和标准差。
metrics.en: Win rate against built-in opponents; terminal win/loss reward is +1/−1, with mean and standard deviation over training repetitions.

controls.zh: 10,000 局评测，5 次训练重复；标准训练 agent frame skip=50，对手 frame skip 单独控制；随机初始状态。
controls.en: 10,000 evaluation games and five training repetitions; standard trained-agent frame skip is 50, with opponent skip controlled separately; randomized initial states.

limits.zh: 宏动作策略评测，不是鼠标级 RTS 微操；内置 AI 可见全局状态，信息优势不对称须保留。
limits.en: Macro-action strategy evaluation, not mouse-level RTS microcontrol; built-in opponents have full-state information, an important asymmetry.

basis.zh: 有限资源需在经济、设施和进攻部队之间取舍，并适应不同对手。
basis.en: Limited resources require trade-offs among economy, facilities and attack forces against different opponents.

basis.zh: 平均约 4,000 ticks 才产生胜负奖励，需维持整局目标。
basis.en: Win/loss reward arrives after roughly 4,000 ticks on average, requiring sustained game-level objectives.

label.zh: Malmo：Cliff Walking 官方学习示例
label.en: Malmo: official Cliff Walking learning example

task.zh: 在 Minecraft 中构造的悬崖网格绕开熔岩，到达青金石目标方块。
task.en: Navigate the cliff grid constructed in Minecraft, avoiding lava and reaching the lapis goal block.

observation.zh: 官方表格 Q-learning 智能体使用 JSON XPos/ZPos 位置；视频仅用于调试，不是本策略输入。
observation.en: The official tabular Q-learning agent uses JSON XPos/ZPos coordinates; video is for debugging rather than policy input.

action.zh: 向北、南、西、东移动的离散命令。
action.en: Discrete move-north, move-south, move-west and move-east commands.

metrics.zh: 逐回合累计奖励：目标 +100、熔岩 −100、每个命令 −1。
metrics.en: Per-episode cumulative reward: +100 at the goal, −100 for lava and −1 per command.

controls.zh: 基于固定 mission XML 的起点/目标，脚本每张地图额外随机插入熔岩坑；每地图重复 150 回合。比较时记录随机种子和生成布局，触碰熔岩或目标终止。
controls.en: Use fixed mission XML start/goal; the script inserts random lava holes per map and repeats 150 episodes per map. Record random seed and generated layout for comparison; contact with lava or goal terminates the episode.

limits.zh: 官方平台学习示例，不是独立通用 Minecraft 基准或视觉导航评测；原论文 PDF 本轮返回 403，协议依据为作者仓库。
limits.en: An official platform learning example, not an independent general Minecraft benchmark or visual-navigation test; the paper PDF returned 403, so protocol evidence comes from the authors’ repository.

basis.zh: 路径长度与接近熔岩风险影响累计回报，需选择安全到达路线。
basis.en: Path length and lava risk affect return, requiring a safe route to the goal.

basis.zh: 格子位置、障碍和目标之间的关系约束移动路径。
basis.en: Grid positions, hazards and goal relations constrain feasible routes.

task.zh: 在 Gen 1 OU 与 Gen 9 OU 规则下同基线及社区 agent 对战。
task.en: Compete against baseline and community agents under Gen 1 OU and Gen 9 OU formats.

observation.zh: 玩家可见的队伍、当前场面与历史；对方未揭示的队伍配置保持隐藏。
observation.en: Player-visible team, current battle state and history; unrevealed opponent team configuration remains hidden.

action.zh: 每回合同时选择合法招式或换人等对战动作，通常约 9 个可选动作。
action.en: Simultaneously choose legal moves or switches each turn, typically from about nine actions.

metrics.zh: 主要指标为完整对局历史拟合的 FH-BT 评级及 bootstrap 不确定性；另报 Glicko-1 和 GXE。
metrics.en: Primary metric is full-history Bradley–Terry rating with bootstrap uncertainty; Glicko-1 and GXE are also reported.

controls.zh: 专用 AI 服务器，分别报告两种规则及标准/Extended Timer 时限；保持参赛策略固定。
controls.en: Dedicated AI server; report formats and standard/Extended Timer regimes separately, with evaluated policies fixed.

limits.zh: 不是人类公开天梯的同一分布；动态参赛池和最低对局数影响评级，不能跨计时规则直接比较。
limits.en: Not the same distribution as the public human ladder; evolving agent pools and minimum match counts affect ratings, and timer regimes are not directly interchangeable.

basis.zh: 不完全信息、随机招式结果与换人取舍要求对抗策略。
basis.en: Imperfect information, stochastic moves and switching trade-offs require adversarial strategy.

label.zh: PokéAgent：绿宝石首个道馆长程任务

task.zh: 从小田卷相关开局流程推进至击败第一个道馆馆主 Roxanne，完成标准里程碑。
task.en: Progress through the initial journey to defeat first gym leader Roxanne, completing standardized milestones.

observation.zh: 游戏画面及有限队伍物种/等级、状态和 HP；不直接暴露谜题状态、动态障碍、物品和招式集。
observation.en: Game frames and limited party species/levels, status and HP; puzzle states, dynamic obstacles, items and movesets are not directly exposed.

action.zh: 向模拟器发出按键；具体 harness 可加入寻路/知识/记忆工具，须单列其配置。
action.en: Send button inputs to the emulator; harness-specific pathfinding, knowledge and memory tools must be recorded separately.

metrics.zh: 里程碑完成百分比；100% 完成者按完成时间比较，同分以动作次数区分。
metrics.en: Milestone completion percentage; completion time for 100% finishers, with action count as a tie-breaker.

controls.zh: 固定首道馆范围和游戏服务器帧率；比较时按状态、工具、记忆、反馈、微调五轴对齐 harness×model 条件。
controls.en: Fix first-gym scope and server frame rate; align harness×model conditions across state, tools, memory, feedback and finetuning.

limits.zh: 不是完整通关；工具辅助和多 agent 架构不是被独立测量的游戏内协作能力；时间/成本随 harness 变化。
limits.en: Not a full-game completion task; tool assistance and multi-agent architecture do not independently measure in-game cooperation; time/cost vary by harness.

basis.zh: 首道馆流程跨数千次交互，要求持续推进多阶段目标。
basis.en: The first-gym route spans thousands of interactions and sustained multistage objectives.

basis.zh: 路线包含回访、岔路和非线性前置目标。
basis.en: The route includes revisits, branching paths and nonlinear prerequisites.

basis.zh: 长程运行需保留已完成事件与路线进展并处理上下文压缩。
basis.en: Long runs require retaining completed events and route progress through context compaction.

label.zh: gg-bench：新生成规则下的对抗游玩
label.en: gg-bench: adversarial play under generated rules

task.zh: 阅读新生成的双人游戏规则并持续采取行动，击败为该游戏训练的 RL 对手。
task.en: Read generated two-player game rules and act throughout a match to defeat a game-specific RL opponent.

observation.zh: 规则说明、当前棋盘/游戏状态、合法动作列表及动作语义。
observation.en: Rulebook, current board/game state, valid-action list and action semantics.

action.zh: 输出合法动作列表中的一个动作；非法输出会重新提示。
action.en: Output one action from the legal list; invalid outputs trigger reprompting.

metrics.zh: 每游戏 30 局的 LLM 胜率；对 126 游戏的胜率做平均，另分析非法动作错误。
metrics.en: LLM win rate over 30 matches per game, averaged across 126 games; invalid-action faults are analyzed separately.

controls.zh: 固定经过执行/超时筛选的 126 游戏、所选 RL checkpoint；对手从可被另一 checkpoint 以 >80% 胜率击败的配对中选出。
controls.en: Fix the 126 execution/timeout-filtered games and selected RL checkpoints; opponents are chosen from pairs where another checkpoint wins over 80%.

limits.zh: 生成器与筛选策略决定分布，代码仍可能存在边界问题；规则推理是游玩要求，不能解读为独立纯逻辑分数。
limits.en: Generation/filtering define the distribution and edge-case code bugs may remain; rule reasoning is a gameplay requirement, not a separate pure-logic score.

basis.zh: 必须从新规则和动作说明推导当前合法且有效的状态转移。
basis.en: New rules and action descriptions must be applied to legal and effective state transitions.

basis.zh: 最终胜率取决于针对游戏特定 RL 对手的连续对抗决策。
basis.en: Win rate depends on sequential adversarial decisions against game-specific RL opponents.

label.zh: AgenticSTS：固定 A0 有界记忆消融
label.en: AgenticSTS: bounded-memory ablation at fixed A0

task.zh: 在 Slay the Spire 2 的 A0 难度完成整次爬塔，连续处理战斗、组牌、路线、事件和奖励选择。
task.en: Complete Slay the Spire 2 runs at A0, making combat, deckbuilding, route, event and reward decisions.

observation.zh: 结构化文本状态、合法动作、规则检索与按条件启用的记忆/技能；不输入无界累积历史。
observation.en: Structured text state, legal actions, rule retrieval and condition-specific memory/skills, without unbounded accumulated transcripts.

action.zh: 按状态类型输出结构化游戏选择；部分简单决策由机械处理器或 fast tier 执行。
action.en: Produce structured game choices by state type; mechanical handlers or a fast tier resolve some simple decisions.

metrics.zh: 完成对局胜率及 Wilson 95% CI；分析分数胜局为 100，否则 floor+(52/3)×bosses，并以 5,000 次 bootstrap 给区间。
metrics.en: Completed-run win rate with Wilson 95% CI; analysis score is 100 on victory, otherwise floor+(52/3)×bosses, with 5,000-bootstrap intervals.

controls.zh: 五条件各取按开始时间最早的 10 个完成对局；A0 固定、记忆库 SHA1888a62 冻结、禁用赛后写入/技能演化。
controls.en: Use the first ten completed games by start time in each of five conditions; fix A0, freeze stores at SHA1888a62 and disable postrun writes/evolution.

basis.zh: 整次运行跨多阶段和大量决策，要求维持爬塔目标。

basis.zh: 组牌、路线和战斗选择影响后续资源与生存。

label.zh: DareFightingICE：官方 LLM 对 MCTS 示例

task.zh: 控制 ZEN 角色实时对战 MctsAi23i，反复根据最新状态选择格斗招式。
task.en: Control ZEN in real-time fights against MctsAi23i, repeatedly selecting fighting moves from updated state.

observation.zh: 双方 HP、能量、当前动作/状态、位置包围盒、速度、弹幕及当前帧编号的结构化文本。
observation.en: Structured text for both fighters’ HP, energy, action/state, bounding boxes, speeds, projectiles and current frame number.

action.zh: 模型输出格斗命令，由 CommandCenter 转为按键序列；后续命令序列可连续执行。
action.en: Model-generated fighting commands are converted by CommandCenter into key sequences; queued commands may execute sequentially.

metrics.zh: 官方 agent 在回合结束记录双方剩余 HP 和经过帧数；代码即时奖励为造成伤害减自身损失。
metrics.en: The official agent records both remaining HP values and elapsed frames at round end; instantaneous reward is damage dealt minus own HP lost.

controls.zh: 固定 ZEN 对 ZEN、MctsAi23i、模型和提示/示例数量；runner 默认 1 局，game_num 可配置；处理逻辑使用 3,600 帧边界。
controls.en: Fix ZEN versus ZEN, MctsAi23i, model and prompt/few-shot settings; runner defaults to one game with configurable game_num; processing uses a 3,600-frame boundary.

limits.zh: 仅接入官方 LLM 参考对战协议，不宣称这些记录字段就是 2026 比赛总排名公式；比赛轮数、评分汇总和最终模型限制仍需核对发布规则包。
limits.en: Only the official LLM reference-match protocol is registered; recorded fields are not asserted to be the 2026 competition ranking formula. Competition round counts, aggregation and final model limits still require the released rules package.

basis.zh: 角色移动、攻击和防御招式需随实时局面反馈执行。
basis.en: Movement, attack and defensive commands must respond to real-time fighting state.

task.zh: 采集、合成和生存，在二维随机地图中逐步解锁成就。
task.en: Gather, craft and survive while unlocking achievements in procedurally generated 2D worlds.

observation.zh: SmartPlay 风格的局部场景和状态文字；VLM 模式可增加图像历史。
observation.en: SmartPlay-style local scene and state text; VLM mode can additionally use image history.

action.zh: 17 个文字动作映射到离散操作，包括移动、Do、Sleep、放置设施和制作工具或武器。
action.en: 17 text actions map to discrete controls: movement, Do, Sleep, placing facilities and crafting tools or weapons.

metrics.zh: score 为已解锁的不同成就数；progression = score / 22。逐项 achievements 同时保留，用于区分资源、制作和战斗进展。
metrics.en: score counts distinct unlocked achievements; progression = score / 22. The achievements dictionary is retained to separate resource, crafting and combat progress.

controls.zh: 当前配置每环境 10 局；地图 64×64，局部视野 9×9，图像 256×256；每局最多 2000 步。
controls.en: Current configuration: 10 episodes, 64×64 world, 9×9 view, 256×256 images and at most 2,000 steps per episode.

limits.zh: 此项采用 BALROG 包装与配置，不能直接等同原生环境的训练协议。
limits.en: This uses the BALROG wrapper and configuration, rather than the native environment training protocol.

label.en: Overcooked: evaluation with independently trained partners

task.zh: 与行为偏好不同、未共同训练的伙伴合作烹饪并交付菜品。
task.en: Cook and deliver dishes with behaviorally diverse partners not trained jointly with the evaluated agent.

observation.zh: Overcooked 包装提供的厨房状态；保留具体布局和观测处理配置。
observation.en: Kitchen state from the Overcooked wrapper; retain layout and observation-processing configuration.

action.zh: 移动、停留及与厨房对象交互。
action.en: Movement, waiting and kitchen-object interaction.

metrics.zh: 团队回报及 BR-Prox：相对同一伙伴的最佳响应表现衡量协调能力；BR-Div 用于伙伴选择。
metrics.en: Team return and BR-Prox relative to best-response performance with the same partner; BR-Div is used to select partners.

controls.zh: 按布局生成行为偏好候选，选择评测伙伴，保存 policy_pool YAML 和相应最佳响应模型。
controls.en: Generate behavior-biased candidates by layout, select partners and retain policy_pool YAMLs and best-response models.

limits.zh: 伙伴生成、选择和评测是不同阶段；普通 self-play 分数不替代零样本伙伴评测。
limits.en: Partner generation, selection and evaluation are separate stages; self-play score does not substitute for zero-shot partner evaluation.

evidence.title: ZSC-Eval toolkit and evaluation workflow
evidence.excerpt: Behavior-preferring partners, BR-Div selection, BR-Prox measurement and policy pool configuration.

basis.zh: 与未共同训练伙伴合作完成共享任务。
basis.en: Complete a shared task with independently trained partners.

observation.zh: 环境观测与同步动作，接入固定策略伙伴；语言 Agent 需要独立适配，不默认具备聊天通道。
observation.en: Environment observations and simultaneous actions with fixed policy partners; language agents need a separate adapter, without an assumed chat channel.

action.zh: 环境观测与同步动作，接入固定策略伙伴；语言 Agent 需要独立适配，不默认具备聊天通道。

metrics.zh: 文档指标包括团队回报与 Best-Response Proximity。报告伙伴分布、区间估计和参考策略；归一化值不保证严格小于 1。
metrics.en: Documented measures include team return and Best-Response Proximity. Report partner distribution, uncertainty and reference policies; normalization is not a strict bound of one.

controls.zh: 固定布局、伙伴池、伙伴训练预算、角色交换与最佳回应参照；伙伴多样性影响结论。

limits.zh: 需锁定伙伴检查点及观测/动作适配，验证与 Collab-Overcooked 的环境差异；分别计分。

label.zh: 星际争霸 II · 完整对局

task.zh: 采用 Orak 的 StarCraft II 完整 1v1 对局，对手为固定配置的游戏 AI。
task.en: Use Orak’s full StarCraft II 1v1 match against a game AI with a fixed configuration.

observation.zh: 通过 Orak 的游戏状态与动作工具交互；具体模态、查询间隔和动作批量须固定。
observation.en: Use Orak’s game-state and action tools; pin modality, query interval and action batching.

action.zh: 通过 Orak 的游戏状态与动作工具交互；具体模态、查询间隔和动作批量须固定。
action.en: Use Orak’s game-state and action tools; pin modality, query interval and action batching.

metrics.zh: 文档指标：胜率。Arena 建议补充：资源利用、发展阶段、决策延迟和停滞轨迹；须先验证记录器。
metrics.en: Documented measure: win rate. Proposed diagnostics: resource use, development stages, latency and stalls; recorders need validation.

controls.zh: 固定地图、双方种族、AI 难度与风格、决策频率和预算；不与 SMACv2 微操胜率混合。
controls.en: Fix map, races, AI difficulty/style, decision frequency and budget. Do not pool this win rate with SMACv2 micromanagement.

limits.zh: 需安装游戏、固定配置并验证 Orak 适配；仓库中 SC2 的 MCP 路线仍标注开发中。
limits.en: Game installation, pinned configuration and adapter validation are required; the SC2 MCP path is marked work in progress.

basis.zh: 经济、生产、科技与战斗需要共同取舍，补充微操任务无法覆盖的宏观决策。
basis.en: Economy, production, technology and combat create trade-offs beyond micromanagement scenarios.

label.zh: 双臂老虎机 · 交互学习

task.zh: SmartPlay 双臂老虎机：收益概率未知，通过多轮选择获取反馈。
task.en: SmartPlay’s two-armed bandit: infer unknown reward probabilities through repeated choices and feedback.

observation.zh: 文本历史、每轮动作和收益反馈；选择两臂之一。
observation.en: Text history, per-round choices and reward feedback; select one of two arms.

action.zh: 文本历史、每轮动作和收益反馈；选择两臂之一。
action.en: Text history, per-round choices and reward feedback; select one of two arms.

metrics.zh: 任务指标：累计收益。Arena 建议补充：已知生成概率下的遗憾值与选择比例，需明确定义估计方式。

observation.zh: 原生 DoomGame 或 Gymnasium；屏幕观测，7个二元按键。建议固定 MultiBinary 版本，额外状态缓冲单独声明。

action.zh: 原生 DoomGame 或 Gymnasium；屏幕观测，7个二元按键。建议固定 MultiBinary 版本，额外状态缓冲单独声明。

metrics.zh: 回合累计奖励：向目标接近/远离产生距离增量奖励，到达目标 +1000，死亡 -100。 目标到达率、死亡率与耗时，作为 Arena 补充统计。

controls.zh: 固定 WAD/CFG 与软件版本、doom_skill=5、2100 tic 上限。 固定 frame_skip、动作组合、屏幕分辨率、可见辅助信息及随机种子列表。

limits.zh: 单人对怪物场景；不是多模型对战或独立策略能力测量。原生 RL 接口已记录，LLM/VLM 动作适配尚未实现或验证。 待锁定资源与版本、逐任务预算、种子清单和适配器，并完成运行验证。

label.zh: 足球学院：三打一与守门员

task.zh: 仅在三名受控球员分别由可行动主体控制时，将传跑配合归为协作；单控制器模式应改列策略/控制。
task.en: Count coordination only when three controllable players are assigned distinct acting policies; single-controller mode belongs under strategy/control.

observation.zh: create_environment，建议 raw 观测；number_of_left_players_agent_controls=3，右侧0；每次传入三个动作，默认动作集19项。
observation.en: create_environment with raw observations, three controlled left players and zero right players; supply three actions from the default 19-action set.

action.zh: create_environment，建议 raw 观测；number_of_left_players_agent_controls=3，右侧0；每次传入三个动作，默认动作集19项。
action.en: create_environment with raw observations, three controlled left players and zero right players; supply three actions from the default 19-action set.

metrics.zh: scoring 回报为比分差的变化；原生暴露 score 与 info.score_reward。 固定 scoring-only 时统计进球成功率、球权丢失与出界终止次数；不得把传球次数单独当作协作水平。
metrics.en: Scoring reward is the change in score difference; native fields include score and info.score_reward. Under scoring-only evaluation report scoring success, possession-loss and out-of-play endings; pass count alone is not coordination quality.

controls.zh: 官方场景：game_duration=400，随机环境，关闭越位；进球、出界或球权改变即终止。 固定三主体分配、共享信息/通信规则、对手、种子、动作集及物理步频；区分 scoring 与 checkpoints 塑形。
controls.en: Official scenario uses game_duration=400, stochastic dynamics, offsides disabled, and termination on score, out-of-play or possession change. Fix policy-to-player assignment, shared information/communication, opponents, seeds, action set and physics step frequency; distinguish scoring from checkpoint shaping.

limits.zh: 短攻门场景，不代表完整11人足球比赛或长期战略。原生多球员接口需要调度层分派到独立 Agent；当前任务未接入运行，LLM/VLM 支持未核验。 待锁定资源与版本、逐任务预算、种子清单和适配器，并完成运行验证。
limits.en: A short attacking scenario, not full 11-a-side football or long-term strategy. The multi-player interface needs a dispatcher for independent agents; no runner is connected and LLM/VLM support is unverified. Pin assets and versions, per-task budgets, seed lists and adapters; complete runtime validation.

observation.zh: CommunicationModPlus 交换 JSON 状态与文本命令；模型使用按名称选牌、选路线等工具。

metrics.zh: 官方指标：平均完成幕数、各幕通关率、终止楼层、每局成本。按本任务协议报告，不合并为跨游戏总分。
metrics.en: Documented metrics: Mean acts cleared, Per-act win rates, Final floor, Cost per run. Report within this task protocol; do not aggregate into a cross-game score.

controls.zh: 固定游戏与模组版本、A20、Ironclad、种子序列、术语重命名、记忆模式、推理设置和动作批处理。论文主表用相同十种子及 themed reskin；可写记忆按种子顺序传递。
controls.en: Fix game/mod versions, A20, Ironclad, seed order, reskin, memory mode, reasoning and action batching. Main results use ten shared seeds with themed reskin; writable memory carries sequentially.

limits.zh: 尚未核实论文专用仓库和完整种子清单；需商业游戏。十种子不足以可靠区分相邻模型，不是像素控制评测。 待固定实验清单、预算和运行器；论文实验数量不自动成为 Arena 默认预算。
limits.en: Paper-specific repository and exact seed list are unverified; commercial game required. Ten seeds cannot reliably order nearby models; this is not pixel-control evaluation. Pin manifests, budgets and runners; paper experiment counts are not adopted as Arena defaults.

task.zh: 在官方双人 Ryu 镜像场景中比较双方策略，记录回合胜负及固定对手池的对战矩阵。
task.en: Compare policies in the official two-player Ryu mirror scenario, recording round outcomes and a fixed-pool matchup matrix.

observation.zh: Gym Retro 图像接口；原始按键与转换动作空间可选，特殊招式宏需单独声明。原生基线为 RL。
observation.en: Gym Retro pixel interface, with raw-button or transformed actions; declare special-move macros. Native baselines use RL.

action.zh: Gym Retro 图像接口；原始按键与转换动作空间可选，特殊招式宏需单独声明。原生基线为 RL。

metrics.zh: 以回合胜率和固定池 Elo 比较；如运行统一 RL 攻击者，则另外报告其胜率，作为近似可利用性诊断。
metrics.en: Compare round win rate and fixed-pool Elo; a consistently trained RL exploiter may additionally provide an approximate exploitability diagnostic.

controls.zh: 固定 Genesis 版本、存档、Ryu 双方角色、动作宏、帧堆叠与动作保持；记录左右侧、对手池及奖励设置。
controls.en: Pin Genesis version, saves, Ryu characters, action macros, frame stacking and action duration; record sides, opponent pool and rewards.

limits.zh: 待游戏资源和 runner 校验；确定对局数、时序及预算。LLM/VLM 控制适配未验证；不把 Elo 当作绝对能力分。
limits.en: Pending game assets, runner validation, match counts, timing and budgets. LLM/VLM adapters are unverified; Elo is not an absolute capability score.

basis.en: The early cue is absent from the local observation at decision time, exposing history use while retaining navigation and encoding effects.

label.zh: 原版 CoinRun：500关训练与测试

task.zh: 比较固定训练关卡与测试关卡的回报，研究平台跳跃策略的过拟合。
task.en: Compare return on fixed training levels and test levels to study platformer overfitting.

observation.zh: 原始 CoinRun VecEnv；图像观测、离散动作、回合回报与结束信号。
observation.en: Original CoinRun VecEnv; image observations, discrete actions, rewards and episode termination.

action.zh: 原始 CoinRun VecEnv；图像观测、离散动作、回合回报与结束信号。
action.en: Original CoinRun VecEnv; image observations, discrete actions, rewards and episode termination.

metrics.zh: enjoy.py 汇总每回合回报并输出 mean_score / mpi_mean；训练与测试结果分开。 可增加 train-test 回报差，但不要将其直接当作通用模型分数。
metrics.en: enjoy.py aggregates episode returns into mean_score / mpi_mean; train and test scores are separate. Optionally report the train-test return gap; it is not a universal model score.

controls.zh: 原论文500关设置为 NUM_LEVELS=500、SET_SEED=-1；固定训练预算、难度、模型检查点与评估回合数。 固定游戏版本、图像处理、帧堆叠及速度信息绘制；明确测试采样机制。
controls.en: Original 500-level setting uses NUM_LEVELS=500 and SET_SEED=-1; fix training budget, difficulty, checkpoint and evaluation episode count. Fix game version, image processing, frame stack and velocity overlay; disclose test sampling.

limits.zh: 官方测试脚本从高难度关卡总体抽样，未显式排除训练关卡，只说明碰撞概率很低。因此不能声称严格无重叠，除非新增排除检查。仓库已归档；与 Procgen CoinRun 不混用。 待锁定资源与版本、逐任务预算、种子清单和适配器，并完成运行验证。
limits.en: Official testing samples high-difficulty levels without explicitly excluding training levels, relying on negligible collision probability. Strict disjointness requires an added audit. Repository archived; keep separate from Procgen CoinRun. Pin assets and versions, per-task budgets, seed lists and adapters; complete runtime validation.
