label.zh: 代码技能 · 制作目标 · 依赖执行
label.en: Code skills · Crafting targets · Prerequisite execution

task.zh: 按 success_condition 配置制作目标。官方汇总指标列出 8 个目标，包括工作台、石镐、熔炉、水桶、金剑、钻石镐、附魔台与下界传送门。
task.en: Crafting targets configured by success_condition. The documented aggregate covers eight targets: crafting table, stone pickaxe, furnace, bucket, golden sword, diamond pickaxe, enchanting table and nether portal.

observation.zh: 文本状态包含生物群系、附近方块与实体、生命、饥饿、位置、装备、库存及箱子信息。
observation.en: Text state includes biome, nearby blocks/entities, health, hunger, position, equipment, inventory and chests.

action.zh: 生成 JavaScript 异步函数，调用提供的控制技能。
action.en: Generate asynchronous JavaScript functions using provided control skills.

metrics.zh: 官方汇总：完成的制作目标数 / 8 × 100。单任务 evaluator 按配置目标检查装备或库存；与汇总指标分开记录。
metrics.en: Documented aggregate: completed crafting targets / 8 × 100. The single-task evaluator checks configured targets in equipment or inventory; record it separately from the aggregate.

controls.zh: 制作目标、初始世界与库存、技能库、代码执行限制、提示词及调用预算。
controls.en: Crafting target, initial world/inventory, skill library, code-execution constraints, prompts and inference budget.

limits.zh: 下界传送门目标如何对应通用库存检查尚未确认；未固定提交，安装与运行成本未核验。
limits.en: How the nether-portal target maps to the generic inventory check remains unresolved. No pinned commit; installation and running costs unverified.

basis.zh: 适合研究代码技能调用与制作目标执行；与 MineDojo 低层动作或 SmartPlay 导航的分数不可直接互换。
basis.en: Useful for code-skill use and crafting-goal execution; scores are not interchangeable with MineDojo low-level control or SmartPlay navigation.

task.zh: 去中心化多智能体微操战斗；随机初始位置与单位构成，不覆盖完整 RTS 的建造和运营。
task.en: Decentralized multi-agent micromanagement with randomized starting positions and unit composition; excludes full RTS construction and economy.

observation.zh: 每个单位的局部观测；全局状态、视野与附加特征由配置决定。
observation.en: Local observations per unit; global state, sight range and additional features depend on configuration.

action.zh: 单位级移动、停止、攻击或治疗，带可用动作约束。
action.en: Unit-level movement, stop, attack or heal, subject to available-action constraints.

metrics.zh: 团队胜率：battles_won / battles_game；另记录超时等统计。
metrics.en: Team win rate: battles_won / battles_game; additional statistics include timeouts.

controls.zh: capability config、单位数量与分布、视野、地图、StarCraft II 版本及环境步进。
controls.en: Capability configuration, unit counts/distributions, sight range, map, StarCraft II version and environment stepping.

limits.zh: 需要 StarCraft II 与地图资源；未安装或运行，未固定配置、种子及训练预算。
limits.en: Requires StarCraft II and map assets; not installed or run. Configuration, seeds and training budget are not pinned.

basis.zh: 适合局部观测下的团队协同控制与场景变化研究；不用于直接评价完整游戏宏观战略。
basis.en: Useful for team control under partial observability and changing scenarios; not a direct full-game macro-strategy evaluation.

label.zh: 完整对局 · 高层策略动作

task.zh: 完整 1v1 对内置 AI 的对局；示例配置为 Protoss 对 Zerg，不据此推定覆盖所有种族。
task.en: Full 1v1 matches against a built-in AI; the example config is Protoss versus Zerg, which does not establish coverage of all races.

observation.zh: 文本摘要包含资源、建筑、单位、科研、进行中动作及敌人信息；源码另有可选图像输入。
observation.en: Text summaries include resources, buildings, units, research, ongoing actions and enemy information; the implementation also has optional image input.

action.zh: 从预定义的高层动作词典中选择动作。
action.en: Choose actions from a predefined high-level action dictionary.

metrics.zh: 对 AI bot 的胜场 / 总场次 × 100。与 SMACv2 微操胜率的评估单位不同。
metrics.en: Wins against the AI bot / total matches × 100. The evaluation unit differs from SMACv2 micromanagement win rate.

controls.zh: 地图、双方种族、AI 难度与风格、查询间隔、动作批量、观测模态及模型预算。
controls.en: Map, player/opponent races, AI difficulty/style, query interval, action batch, observation modality and model budget.

limits.zh: MCP 模式完成度、安装兼容性与实际运行成本未核验；未固定提交或复现实验。
limits.en: MCP-mode readiness, installation compatibility and actual running costs remain unverified; no pinned commit or independent reproduction.

basis.zh: 适合研究高层策略动作与完整对局执行；与 SMACv2 比较时应对照研究范围，而非直接比较胜率。
basis.en: Useful for high-level strategic actions and full-match execution. Compare research scope with SMACv2 rather than ranking their win rates.

label.zh: 通信 · 分工 · 协作过程
label.en: Communication · Division of work · Collaboration process

task.zh: 两名厨师 / 助手协作完成订单；修改版研究环境扩展菜谱与食材。
task.en: Two cooks / assistants collaborate on orders; the modified research environment extends recipes and ingredients.

observation.zh: 订单、环境状态、可用技能与自然语言沟通信息。
observation.en: Orders, environment state, available skills and natural-language communication.

action.zh: 技能执行与通信；main.py 将联合动作送入环境推进。
action.en: Skill execution and communication; main.py advances the environment with joint actions.

metrics.zh: 任务结果：成功率、成功轨迹的完成时间步。协作过程：参考动作序列相似度 / 冗余、发起与响应协作统计。时间步不是墙钟延迟。
metrics.en: Task outcomes: success rate and completion timestep for successful trajectories. Collaboration process: reference-action sequence similarity/redundancy and initiation/response statistics. Timesteps are not wall-clock latency.

controls.zh: 菜谱、布局、伙伴模型、通信规则、时限和参考动作序列。安装示例的 horizon 不是统一评测预算。
controls.en: Recipe, layout, partner models, communication rules, horizon and reference action sequence. The installation example horizon is not a universal evaluation budget.

limits.zh: 未固定提交或复现实验；过程指标不等于独立人工评价，需结合任务完成结果。
limits.en: No pinned commit or independent reproduction. Process metrics are not independent human evaluation and should be read alongside task outcomes.

basis.zh: 适合分析语言智能体如何分工、发起和响应协作；同时观察任务结果与交互过程。
basis.en: Useful for analyzing division of work and collaboration initiation/response, alongside task outcomes.

label.zh: 资源分割下的团队建造

task.zh: 解决本地可恢复、必要协作、灰区和协作失败四类瓶颈。
task.en: Resolve local-recovery, necessary-coordination, gray-zone and failed-cooperation bottlenecks.

observation.zh: 私有库存/位置/任务/阻塞历史，与受限公共请求状态。
observation.en: Private inventory/position/task/blockage history and restricted public request state.

action.zh: 本地 craft/smelt/collect/plan，或 REQUEST_MATERIAL/OFFER_TRANSFER 等协议。
action.en: Local craft/smelt/collect/plan or REQUEST_MATERIAL/OFFER_TRANSFER protocols.

metrics.zh: TSR、所有代理环境动作总数 CS；本地解决率、无效升级率、有效沟通率、恢复成功率。
metrics.en: TSR, summed environment-action count CS, local resolution, unnecessary escalation, effective communication and recovery success.

controls.zh: MindCraft 40 模板×5种子，2/3代理分别120/80回合；VillagerAgent 另设资源隔离蓝图。
controls.en: MindCraft: 40 templates × five seeds, 120/80 episodes with two/three agents; VillagerAgent uses separately resource-isolated blueprints.

limits.zh: TSR 在文中描述为方块级建造质量；不能与二元整任务成功率混同。公开仓库未定位，高协作蓝图、种子与完整执行预算待可下载配置核对。
limits.en: TSR is described as block-level construction quality and is not interchangeable with binary episode success. No public repository located; downloadable high-coordination blueprints, seeds and full execution budgets remain unconfirmed.

basis.zh: 有意拆分资源以让成功依赖代理间状态改变的协作。
basis.en: Resource splits make task completion depend on state-changing cooperation.

basis.zh: 判断本地恢复或升级请求以解除依赖。
basis.en: Chooses local recovery or escalation to remove dependencies.

label.zh: Defend the Center 实时控制

task.zh: 圆形场地中生存并击杀持续出现的敌人。
task.en: Survive and frag continuously spawning enemies in a circular arena.

observation.zh: 40×25 ASCII 画面与深度网格，来源 640×480 HUD 开启图像。
observation.en: 40×25 ASCII/depth grids from 640×480 HUD-enabled images.

action.zh: shoot、move_forward、turn_left、turn_right，允许兼容组合。
action.en: Shoot, move_forward, turn_left and turn_right, including compatible combinations.

metrics.zh: 存活决策步数、跨回合总击杀、推理延迟；另有匹配控制条件。
metrics.en: Survival decision steps, cumulative frags and inference latency, with additional matched-control conditions.

controls.zh: 每回合最多 2,100 tics，frame_skip=4；不同模型 3/5/10 回合。
controls.en: At most 2,100 tics per episode, frame_skip=4; models use 3/5/10 episodes.

limits.zh: 仅一个场景；模型接收不同编码的等价 ASCII/深度信息，未给 LLM 原始视觉；回合数 3/5/10 不同，总击杀不能直接作等预算排名。训练为人类示范监督学习。
limits.en: One scenario; LLMs receive text ASCII/depth rather than raw vision. Episode counts differ (3/5/10), so cumulative frags are not equal-budget rankings. The small model uses supervised human demonstrations.

basis.zh: 持续根据观测选择转向、移动和射击。
basis.en: Continuously chooses turning, movement and shooting from observations.

label.zh: 四代理末影龙生存案例

task.zh: 从随机新世界资源获取、制作、探索到击败末影龙。
task.en: Gather, craft and explore from a new random world to defeat the Ender Dragon.

observation.zh: Mineflayer 文本状态/事件、游戏聊天、私有及共享记忆。
observation.en: Mineflayer textual state/events, game chat, private/shared memory.

action.zh: 代理编写并运行 Mineflayer JavaScript；四名实际玩家。
action.en: Agent-written Mineflayer JavaScript programs controlling four players.

metrics.zh: 终点完成、墙钟时长、死亡次数、生成程序数量与运行轨迹。
metrics.en: Endpoint completion, wall-clock duration, deaths, generated-program count and run traces.

controls.zh: Java 1.20.4、生存/Easy、作弊关闭；一个运行，没有固定时长预算。
controls.en: Java 1.20.4, survival/Easy, cheats disabled; one run without a fixed time budget.

limits.zh: 单次随机世界案例，不能形成重复种子的稳定模型排行榜；没有固定 API 预算及跨种子成功率。
limits.en: One random-world case study, not a repeated-seed model ranking; fixed API budget and cross-seed success rate are absent.

basis.zh: 跨一整天保持通关目标与依赖链。
basis.en: Maintains the completion goal and dependencies across more than a day.

basis.zh: 团队通过聊天和共享记忆分工并恢复损失。
basis.en: Team divides work and recovers losses through chat/shared memory.

basis.zh: 推进制作、维度转换与末影龙依赖。
basis.en: Advances crafting, dimension-transition and dragon prerequisites.

limits.zh: 精确 seed、每任务预算及 paper 对齐 release 待锁定；VAB 子集另列，不推断所有 MineDojo 任务都已测。
limits.en: Exact seeds, task budgets and paper-aligned release require pinning; VAB remains separate and all MineDojo tasks are not assumed tested.

basis.zh: 预测并修复依赖步骤错误以避免级联失败。
basis.en: Predicts and corrects dependent-step errors to limit cascades.

basis.zh: 采集和多步合成任务含延迟失败链。
basis.en: Gathering/multistep synthesis includes delayed failure chains.

label.zh: 重置目标世界后的经验迁移

task.zh: 木种制作、木工具和石工具三类相关源→目标探针。
task.en: Wood-species, wooden-tool and stone-tool related-source→target probes.

observation.zh: 正常游戏观测，隐藏 graph、verifier 与私有目标坐标；扩展库存/资源事件。
observation.en: Normal game observations and inventory/resource events; graph/verifier/private target coordinates hidden.

action.zh: MineRL 移动、相机、attack/use 和库存操作；文本控制器接入同一接口。
action.en: MineRL movement, camera, attack/use and inventory operations; text controllers map into the same interface.

metrics.zh: TSR、加权图进展 WGP、验证里程碑 VMP；GATG 仅描述性配对对比。
metrics.en: TSR, Weighted Graph Progress and Verified Milestone Progress; GATG is only a descriptive paired contrast.

controls.zh: 五配对种子，no-prior/related/unrelated/shuffled 四条件；每阶段 450 步，源暴露按家族匹配，目标重置。
controls.en: Five paired seeds and no-prior/related/unrelated/shuffled conditions; 450 steps per stage, family-matched source exposure and target reset.

limits.zh: 12 主链与 7 校准/探针链分开；目标世界重置后只传递声明 artifact。五配对种子的区间较宽，不能把图支持的所有能力当成实测提升。
limits.en: Twelve primary and seven calibration/probe chains remain separate. Target worlds reset and only declared artifacts transfer. Five paired seeds yield broad intervals; graph-supported capabilities do not establish measured improvement.

basis.zh: 只允许声明 agent artifact 跨边界，配对控制检验迁移。
basis.en: Only declared agent artifacts transfer across reset boundaries with paired controls.

basis.zh: 依赖任务链要求准备并完成多个先决条件。
basis.en: Dependency chains require preparing multiple prerequisites.

task.en: Twelve primary chains cover resource/tool progression, recipe/item substitutions and collection diversity.

observation.zh: 统一游戏/库存/任务事件观测。
observation.en: Normalized game/inventory/task-event observations.

action.zh: MineRL 原生动作，由相应 agent adapter 执行。
action.en: Native MineRL actions through the evaluated agent adapters.

metrics.zh: TSR、WGP、VMP；按链与阶段报告。
metrics.en: TSR, WGP and VMP by chain/stage.

controls.zh: 九配置各三种子；5/4/3 链分区；7 校准/探针链单列。
controls.en: Nine configurations, three seeds each; 5/4/3-chain partitions; seven calibration/probe chains separate.

limits.zh: 即时执行分数不作经验迁移主张，早期失败会让后续能力未观测。
limits.en: Immediate execution does not establish transfer, and early failures can leave later abilities unobserved.

basis.zh: 跨先决条件链连续执行并记录阶段瓶颈。
basis.en: Executes through prerequisite chains with stage bottleneck logging.

basis.zh: 资源、工具、配方前置依赖构成明确任务图。
basis.en: Resources, tools and recipes form explicit prerequisites.

task.zh: 从指定开局与其他引擎对弈至结束或裁定，比较无搜索策略。
task.en: Plays from selected openings against engines until termination or adjudication.

observation.zh: 当前完整国际象棋局面及合法着法；模型使用FEN/棋盘编码。
observation.en: Current chess position and legal moves, encoded using FEN/board tokens.

action.zh: 选择并执行合法棋步，使棋局更新并轮到对手。
action.en: Executes a legal move and advances the board to the opponent’s turn.

metrics.zh: 对局胜/负/和及BayesElo；与离线棋题准确率分列。
metrics.en: Wins/draws/losses and BayesElo, separate from puzzle accuracy.

controls.zh: 官方脚本每对200局，抽取ECO开局并交换执子颜色；明确模型和对手搜索预算。
controls.en: The released example uses 200 games per pair, sampled ECO openings and swapped colors; model/opponent search budgets remain explicit.

limits.zh: 当前脚本包含Stockfish早停裁定；应固定引擎、检查点及裁定版本。没有核验Chess960协议，本单元不声称该泛化覆盖。
limits.en: Current code uses Stockfish early adjudication; pin engine, checkpoint and adjudication versions. Chess960 was not verified and is outside this unit.

basis.zh: 在规则约束下选择连续对弈着法，以实际对局结果评价策略质量。
basis.en: Selects rule-constrained moves over an actual match, with strategy evaluated by game outcomes.

evidence.excerpt: The repository provides actual tournament matches and BayesElo computation.

evidence.title: Official tournament implementation
evidence.excerpt: Samples ECO opening boards, swaps colors, advances legal moves and records game outcomes; uses Stockfish early adjudication.

task.zh: Leela-CF策略头或价值选步模型，与其他无搜索/固定搜索设置引擎进行真实对局。
task.en: Leela-CF policy or value-based agents play actual games against other engines under specified search settings.

observation.zh: 当前棋盘及模型所需历史/状态辅助信息；不接收像素。
observation.en: Board position with model-specific history/state auxiliaries, not pixels.

action.zh: 选取策略头最高分着法，或评估合法着法并选择价值最高者。
action.en: Takes the highest-ranked policy move or selects among evaluated legal moves.

metrics.zh: 每对200局比赛后计算相对BayesElo；胜负和记录。
metrics.en: Relative BayesElo after 200 games per pair; win/draw/loss records.

controls.zh: 论文第5.2节区分策略选步和逐合法着法价值选步，主实验与消融独立锦标赛。
controls.en: Section 5.2 separates policy and per-legal-move value agents; main and ablation tournaments are separate.

limits.zh: 此单元仅第5.2节无搜索比赛；附录B的完整MCTS引擎计时比赛及Maia-3人类预测另列，不混用预算或指标。
limits.en: Limited to Section 5.2 searchless matches; Appendix B timed MCTS engines and Maia-3 human prediction are distinct protocols.

basis.zh: 在规则约束下选择连续对弈着法，以实际对局结果评价策略质量。
basis.en: Selects rule-constrained moves over an actual match, with strategy evaluated by game outcomes.

evidence.title: Chessformer Section 5.2 evaluation methodology
evidence.excerpt: Defines policy/value move selection and plays 200 actual games per pair to calculate relative BayesElo.
